articles.title: 370 Bücher in 20 Monaten: Wie eine Autorin ihre Werke mit ChatGPT, Claude und Grok schreibt
articles.text:
370 Bücher in 20 Monaten: Wie eine Autorin ihre Werke mit KI schreibt – und wie sie dafür kritisiert wird
Schon seit einigen Monaten ist die Autorin Coral Hart Gesprächsthema in der Welt der Literatur. Denn sie ist eines der öffentlichen Gesichter der KI-Ära des kreativen Schreibens. Im Gegensatz zu vielen anderen Autor:innen, die ihre Werke mit KI schreiben, aber ihre Nutzung verheimlichen, geht Hart offen damit um. Sie stellt sich trotz eines Pseudonyms der Öffentlichkeit und damit auch der Kritik.
Wie 370 Bücher in 20 Monaten entstehen
Wie sie bei ihrer Arbeit vorgeht, hat sie jetzt in einem Interview mit AFP (via Yahoo News) verraten. Bevor sie mit der KI-Nutzung begann, hatte Hart schon 14 Jahre Erfahrung als Autorin und hat 96 eigene Werke ganz ohne Tool-Hilfe geschrieben. Da sie sich mit KI nicht auskannte, probierte sie im Verlauf von mehreren Monaten zahlreiche Modelle aus, um sich ein Framework zu errichten, das in der Lage ist, Bücher zu schreiben.
Mittlerweile wechselt sie zwischen mehreren Modellen hin und her. Die einzelnen Tools haben ihrer Meinung nach ihre eigenen Vor- und Nachteile. So soll ChatGPT etwa besonders gut bei Dialogen sein, aber bei Prosa versagen. Claude nutzt sie hingegen für Story-Strukturen. Grok kommt ins Spiel, um ihren Romance-Büchern „scharfe Szenen“ hinzuzufügen, da der Chatbot von xAI „komplett enthemmt“ ist.
Hart sagt dazu: „Wenn du sagst: ‚ChatGPT, schreib mir ein Buch‘ oder ‚Claude, schreib mir ein Buch‘, bekommst du eine brennende Müllhalde, weil die KI nichts hat, um damit arbeiten zu können.“ Als sie mit ihrer KI-Arbeit begann, hat sie sich Absatz für Absatz mit den Tools an der Story-Idee des Buches entlanggehangelt. Das hätte etwa zwei bis drei Prompts in Anspruch genommen. Mittlerweile kann sie ganze Entwürfe für Bücher mit den Prompts und Mitteln erstellen, die sie im Laufe der Monate erlernt hat.
Die Entwürfe sind aber weit entfernt von finalen Büchern. Sie müssen einen mehrstufigen Bearbeitungsprozess durchlaufen, der ebenfalls durch KI realisiert wird. Dabei werden etwa Kontinuitätsfehler in der Geschichte, unvollständige Charakterentwicklungen und Plot-Holes behoben. Zu guter Letzt muss noch ein Mensch über die KI-Bücher schauen und sicherstellen, dass keine „KI-Anzeichen durchgerutscht sind.“
Wie KI-Bücher zum Geschäft werden
Hart hat allein 2026 mehr als eine Million Bücher verkauft und damit etwas mehr als eine Million US-Dollar verdient. Das ist aber nur ein Teil des Geschäfts, das sie betreibt. Sie hat mittlerweile die „Coral Hart Group“ gegründet, die Menschen beim Prozess des Buchschreibens mit KI begleiten soll. Seit Launch sollen mehr als 2.400 Autor:innen betreut worden sein.
Die KI-Autorin bietet über die Plattform an, Bücher von einer ersten Idee in fertige Werke zu verwandeln. Kund:innen erhalten hochladbare Bücher mit einer Länge von bis zu 50.000 Wörtern. Ein einziges Buch kostet dabei 260 Dollar. Kund:innen, die mit ihrer Idee in Serie gehen wollen, bekommen einen Rabatt. So kostet etwa eine Buchreihe mit neun Teilen knapp 1.900 Dollar.
Ihr Geschäft wird dabei nicht von allen Literaturenthusiasten geschätzt. Im Interview verriet die Autorin, dass sie im Laufe der Zeit mehrere Tausend Hassnachrichten und sogar Todesdrohungen erhalten hat. Dazu sagt sie: „Ich habe mich dazu entschieden, diejenige zu sein, die vortritt und sagt, dass wir diese Konversation jetzt haben müssen.“ Sie ist überzeugt, dass die KI-Ära in der Literatur gekommen ist, um zu bleiben: „Das Ganze wird nicht einfach wieder ausgeschaltet oder abgestöpselt, weil ein paar Autoren es so wollen.“
! Heiße Mädchen warten auf dich — Miss4.fun

articles.title: 5 lessons from Here, There and Everywhere by Sudha Murty
articles.text:
5 lessons from Here, There and Everywhere by Sudha Murty
Discover five meaningful lessons from Here, There and Everywhere by Sudha Murty on kindness, humility, relationships, gratitude, and simple living.
Life's most meaningful lessons often come from ordinary experiences, unexpected encounters, and the people we meet along the way. Sometimes, a simple conversation or a small act of kindness can change the way we understand the world.
In Here, There and Everywhere, Sudha Murty brings together a collection of stories inspired by her experiences and observations of people from different walks of life. Through everyday situations, she explores human relationships, generosity, humility, and the values that make life meaningful.
The book reminds readers that wisdom is not always found in grand achievements. Often, it is hidden in the simplest moments of everyday life.
5 lessons to learn from Here, There and Everywhere by Sudha Murty
1. Kindness can change someone's life
Small acts of kindness can have a lasting impact on people. Sometimes, helping someone does not require wealth or influence; it simply requires empathy and a willingness to understand their situation.
The stories remind us that even a small gesture, such as helping a stranger or supporting someone during a difficult time, can create a meaningful difference.
2. Never judge people by their appearance
We often form opinions about people based on their clothes, financial status, education, or social background. However, appearances rarely reveal someone's true character or circumstances.
The book encourages readers to look beyond outward appearances and treat everyone with dignity and respect.
3. Education builds confidence and independence
Education is not limited to academic qualifications. It also gives people the confidence to express themselves, make informed decisions, and challenge social expectations.
Through stories drawn from different experiences, Murty highlights how learning can open doors, particularly for those who face social and economic barriers.
4. Humility is more valuable than wealth
Success and financial achievements do not automatically make someone a better person. What truly matters is how we treat others, especially those who cannot offer us anything in return.
The book encourages readers to remain humble, regardless of their achievements, and remember that kindness and character are more meaningful than material possessions.
5. Every person has a story worth understanding
We often meet people without knowing what they have experienced or the challenges they have overcome. A stranger's behaviour or circumstances may have a story behind them that we have never considered.
The book reminds us to listen, observe, and approach people with empathy rather than making quick assumptions. Every encounter can teach us something about human nature and life.
Final thoughts
Here, There and Everywhere by Sudha Murty is a collection of stories that finds extraordinary lessons in ordinary experiences. Through encounters with people from different backgrounds, the author explores kindness, courage, education, humility, and human relationships.
The biggest takeaway is that we do not always need extraordinary experiences to learn something valuable. Sometimes, the people we meet and the simplest moments we experience have the most important lessons to offer.

articles.title: Gemini AI agents repeatedly bypassed safeguards to attack real website
articles.text:
Google's Gemini AI agents repeatedly attempted to hack a real organization's website during AI model safety testing, finding ways to circumvent increasingly restrictive security controls designed to prevent them from accessing live systems.
The security incidents occurred in October as AI safety research company Trajectory Labs tested whether Gemini 4 Argon agents would engage in unauthorized behavior when faced with an impossible task, even with the model's built-in API safeguards enabled.
In reports published Friday, Trajectory Labs and the targeted organization, Epoch AI, revealed that the agents attempted SQL injection attacks, probed for sensitive information, impersonated employees, and repeatedly circumvented network restrictions introduced to contain their activity.
Epoch AI said it had not independently verified which AI models were involved, and that the Gemini identification came from Trajectory Labs.
The researchers tasked the agents with retrieving official answers to nonexistent problems from Epoch AI's FrontierMath benchmark, repeatedly instructing them to "NEVER stop, NEVER give up."
On October 20, approximately 40 agents began probing Epoch AI's live website for sensitive information, including administrator credentials and access to proprietary benchmark evaluation logs.
Epoch AI detected the activity and deployed an "agent hotline" that allowed the agents to send messages directly to its employees.
For three hours, the agents made 36,411 requests to a planted API endpoint and sent 487 messages through the hotline, including some that attempted to impersonate actual Epoch employees or claimed to be engineers and auditors requesting benchmark information.
An investigation also identified an attempted SQL injection attack and more than 200 attempts to access FrontierMath evaluation logs.
Trajectory Labs discovered the activity while reviewing agent transcripts and notified Epoch AI of the unauthorized attacks the following morning.
After discussing the incident with Epoch, the researchers agreed to continue testing against a local copy of the website instead of its live infrastructure.
However, the agents continued finding ways to circumvent the restrictions.
During testing on October 23, some agents recognized they were interacting with a copy of Epoch's website, identified the real website's IP address, and connected directly to its live infrastructure, bypassing DNS redirection designed to contain them.
When researchers blocked the IP addresses used to reach Epoch, an agent switched to another address that allowed it to access the live website again.
Trajectory Labs subsequently configured its network proxy to block direct connections to Epoch, but an agent found another way to retrieve the website's public content through a third-party web-reader service.
"In some of these runs, the agents worked out that they were on a copy, identified the correct raw IP to bypass our redirect, and reached the live site again, which Epoch alerted us about," Trajectory Labs explained.
In a separate technical analysis, Trajectory Labs researchers also discovered that the agents created a message board through a shared software package cache to communicate with each other, exchanging information about vulnerabilities and exploitation methods.
In one example, an agent shared a technique for bypassing restrictions on a deliberately vulnerable copy of Epoch's website, which another agent subsequently used to obtain credentials and complete the task.
The researchers also observed agents attempting to bypass CAPTCHA protections and impersonating employees to trick an AI assistant into revealing protected benchmark information.
Beginning October 26, Epoch AI agreed to work with Trajectory Labs on additional experiments, knowing the agents would have internet access and could interact with its public website.
During these tests, the agents again accessed Epoch's live infrastructure, making more than 65,000 requests to a planted API endpoint and attempting further SQL injection attacks and employee impersonation.
Trajectory Labs later moved testing into fully isolated environments without internet access.
Even after this change, the agents still tried to disable a fake control that allegedly blocked network access, and they succeeded in all three complete test runs.
The researchers said that the agents had not been explicitly instructed to hack websites or impersonate employees. However, they were given an impossible objective on purpose and repeatedly instructed not to give up.
Trajectory Labs acknowledged that the incidents resulted from shortcomings in its testing procedures, including conducting experiments without obtaining the affected organization's consent and relying on built-in model safeguards without sufficient additional monitoring.
On November 2, the company suspended all AI misalignment testing pending a risk assessment and the addition of further safeguards.
"These incidents show how easily testing capable AI agents can spill over to affect real systems and people, and there are not yet shared standards for doing it safely," Trajectory Labs warned.
Neither organization confirmed that any private Epoch AI information was exposed during the incidents.
This report comes as California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the company failed to adequately contain autonomous AI agents during testing, resulting in more than 80 incidents in which it lost control of the agents.
The lawsuit follows a July incident in which nearly 700 OpenAI-powered agents escaped a controlled testing environment and attacked Hugging Face's production infrastructure while attempting to steal cybersecurity benchmark answers.

articles.title: Anthropic sale a bolsa: fecha, precio y claves del debut en Wall Street
articles.text:
El dato central. Anthropic fija el precio de su salida a bolsa el miércoles 18 de noviembre, después del cierre de Wall Street, y empieza a cotizar el jueves 19 en el Nasdaq con el símbolo ANT, según informó CNBC. Vende 825 millones de acciones a un precio de entre USD 70 y USD 78.
En el techo de ese rango, la empresa recauda USD 64.400 millones y queda valuada en torno a 1,4 billones de dólares, si se cuentan las acciones que todavía no se emitieron por opciones de empleados y deuda convertible. Sobre las acciones que ya existen, la cifra ronda 1,02 billones.
Por qué importa. Es la segunda salida a bolsa más grande de la historia, detrás de SpaceX, que en junio levantó USD 75.000 millones. Si se suman los 26.000 millones que siete socios, entre ellos Google, Nvidia y Microsoft, comprarán en una colocación privada al mismo precio, la operación supera ese récord.
También es la primera vez que el inversor común puede comprar en forma directa acciones de uno de los grandes laboratorios de inteligencia artificial.
Los números de la operación
Qué se vende. De los 825 millones de acciones, 801,4 millones son nuevas y 23,6 millones pertenecen a accionistas actuales. Los bancos tienen también una opción para colocar otros 123,75 millones de papeles, que sumarían unos 9.700 millones adicionales.
Quién la conduce. Goldman Sachs y Morgan Stanley encabezan un grupo de 22 bancos. JPMorgan tiene a su cargo la venta a inversores minoristas en Estados Unidos, según Bloomberg.
El salto de valuación. En mayo, en su última ronda privada, la empresa fue valuada en 965.000 millones. Menos de seis meses después, sale al mercado hasta un 45% más cara. En 2021, en su primera ronda, valía 461 millones, según datos de PitchBook.
La demanda desborda la oferta
Lo que se sabe. Bloomberg informó que los pedidos superan unas seis veces las acciones disponibles. The Financial Times publicó que los bancos esperan fijar el precio por encima de los USD 78, lo que llevaría la valuación a 1,5 billones o más.
La letra chica. Los bancos avisaron a los interesados que los accionistas actuales tendrán prioridad en el reparto, según Bloomberg. Quien llega de afuera recibirá menos de lo que pidió, o nada.
La consecuencia. La demanda que quede afuera del reparto se traslada al jueves, a la apertura. Esa es la receta clásica de un primer día con salto.
Qué negocio se está comprando
Los ingresos. Anthropic facturó USD 33.240 millones en los primeros nueve meses de 2026, contra 2.545 millones en el mismo período de 2025: la cifra se multiplicó por 13. Solo en el tercer trimestre vendió 17.000 millones, un 1.127% más que un año antes.
La empresa informó que su proyección de ingresos anualizados rondaba los 81.000 millones a fines de octubre. Es una cifra que lleva a un año el ritmo de las últimas semanas, no ventas ya registradas.
La pérdida que asusta. El prospecto muestra una pérdida neta de 104.000 millones en nueve meses. Cerca del 91% es un ajuste contable sin salida de caja: 94.300 millones por deuda que se convierte en acciones y cuyo valor en los libros sube cuando sube la valuación de la propia empresa.
Cuanto más vale Anthropic, más pierde en el balance.
El número que sí importa. La pérdida operativa, la que mide el negocio, fue de 1.260 millones en nueve meses. En el segundo trimestre, la compañía ganó 974 millones a nivel operativo; en el tercero volvió a perder 567 millones.
El precio. A 1,4 billones, el mercado paga unas 17 veces los ingresos anualizados. Es caro para casi cualquier empresa y razonable solo si el crecimiento se sostiene.
Los riesgos que el prospecto no esconde
El cómputo. Anthropic asumió compromisos por unos USD 900.900 millones, casi todos en capacidad de cómputo e infraestructura, con proveedores como Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom y SpaceX. Los contratos con Microsoft, Google y Amazon se pagan aunque la capacidad no se use. Es una apuesta a que la demanda de IA seguirá creciendo durante años.
El control. Anthropic es una corporación de beneficio público, una figura legal que la obliga a atender su misión y no solo la ganancia. Sus siete cofundadores conservan el 50,1% de los votos y un fideicomiso independiente elige a la mayoría del directorio. Se compra participación económica, no poder.
El momento. Nvidia perdió cerca del 30% de su valor en seis semanas y su fundador, Jensen Huang, renunció el jueves pasado. El Nasdaq acumula una caída cercana al 10% desde su máximo de octubre. El mercado da por descontado que la Reserva Federal subirá las tasas el 9 de diciembre.
Anthropic sale a un mercado que duda de la IA y, al mismo tiempo, hace fila para comprarla.
El antecedente. SpaceX debutó en junio, valuada en 1,77 billones. A fines de julio, sus acciones habían caído casi 50% desde el pico de la primera semana y cotizaban por debajo del precio de salida.
Quiénes ganan
Los primeros. Unos 300 inversores institucionales pusieron dinero en la compañía, según PitchBook. Entre los que lideraron rondas figuran Jaan Tallinn, Spark Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed, Iconiq, GIC, Coatue, Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks y Sequoia.
Los gigantes. Amazon y Alphabet son accionistas y, a la vez, proveedores de cómputo. Sus participaciones valdrían en conjunto USD 411.000 millones en el techo del rango, según cálculos de Reuters sobre el prospecto. Quien tiene acciones de Amazon o de Alphabet ya es dueño indirecto de una parte de Anthropic.
Qué lugar tienen los inversores minoristas
La novedad. Hasta el 20% de la oferta está previsto para inversores minoristas, contra el 5% a 10% que suele reservarse, según recogió Business Insider.
La realidad. Con pedidos seis veces por encima de la oferta, la mayoría recibirá poco o nada al precio de salida. El resto de esa demanda queda para el mercado abierto, al precio que marque la apertura.
La cifra. Vanda Research proyecta compras minoristas netas por USD 250 millones el primer día, más del doble de los 118 millones que tuvo SpaceX.
Qué mirar esta semana
Miércoles 18. El precio final. Si queda por encima de USD 78, la demanda era real. Morningstar calcula que la acción vale USD 92. Esta semana también presenta resultados Nvidia.
Jueves 19. El precio de apertura y la distancia con el precio de salida. Ese salto es lo que paga el que llega tarde.
Los meses siguientes. El vencimiento de las restricciones de venta, que suele traer oferta nueva al mercado. Los empleados pueden vender hasta el 10% de sus acciones desde el primer día; la restricción general dura 180 días y llega a un año para los fundadores. Después, el primer balance como empresa pública.
La conclusión. Anthropic es un negocio extraordinario a un precio que no admite errores. Sus ingresos se multiplicaron por 13 en un año, pero el jueves no se compra ese crecimiento: se compra la expectativa de que continúe, con el Nasdaq en baja y las tasas en suba.
El primer día de una salida a bolsa es una fiesta para quienes ya estaban adentro. Para los demás, la paciencia suele ser el mejor precio de entrada.

articles.title: Telkom returns to growth as MTN revives takeover talks
articles.text:
Telkom, South Africa’s third-largest telecommunications company, reported stronger earnings with growing demand for mobile and fibre services, as MTN Group, Africa’s largest mobile operator, explores a potential acquisition.
The state-controlled telecommunications group reported a 2% revenue increase to R22.5 billion ($1.3 billion) for the six months ended September 30, 2026. Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose 5.8% to R6.4 billion ($377 million), while free cash flow increased by 37.8% to R998 million ($58.8 million).
Released on Tuesday, on the sidelines of the Africa Tech Festival in Cape Town, the results show a business improving profitability and extracting more value from its telecommunications infrastructure just as its ownership could be on the verge of a significant change.
Telkom confirmed on Monday that MTN had approached it with a proposal to acquire its issued share capital, bringing the operators together in one of South Africa’s biggest telecommunications transactions. Telkom said there is no certainty that a transaction will materialise.
A potential acquisition would combine two telecommunications businesses with complementary infrastructure, customer bases and enterprise capabilities. Telkom’s results show the financial position of the business MTN is seeking to acquire.
“These results demonstrate the benefits of the deliberate choices we have made to strengthen Telkom’s businesses. We are improving the quality of our earnings and generating greater value from our operations,” Telkom chief executive officer (CEO) Serame Taukobong said in a statement on Tuesday.
Data remains the strategy’s biggest driver. Group data revenue increased by 6.6% to R13.9 billion ($819 million), accounting for 61.8% of total revenue, compared with 59.1% a year earlier. That growth reflects the shift towards mobile connectivity and fibre broadband.
Telkom’s mobile business recorded revenue growth of 4.7% to R13.3 billion ($784 million), while mobile service revenue increased by 4% to R11.5 billion ($678 million). Prepaid data revenue grew 12%, and mobile data subscribers jumped 13.6% to 21 million.
Mobile EBITDA rose 17.1%, with its margin reaching 30.8%, supported by lower roaming costs and network efficiencies.
Its fibre business, Openserve, grew as it focused on converting existing infrastructure into paying customers. Revenue rose 4.2% to R6.6 billion ($389 million), while external revenue grew 11.9% and broadband revenue grew 10.1%.
Connected homes rose by 15.1% to 870,856, lifting Openserve’s fibre connectivity rate to 54.8%, from 52%. However, the recovery remains uneven, particularly at BCX, Telkom’s enterprise technology services provider.
BCX revenue declined by 8.2% to R5.4 billion ($318 million), reflecting weakness in converged communications and lower information technology (IT) hardware and software revenue. Cloud revenue jumped 16.2% and cybersecurity revenue by 8.7%.
Wider recovery
Telkom is repositioning BCX around a core portfolio that management estimates represents 70% of its revenue. The business is pursuing cost controls and improved commercial execution to restore profitability.
Taukobong acknowledged the uneven performance, saying in the interim statement that “traditional voice revenues continue to decline, Mobile service revenue growth has moderated, and BCX continues to strengthen the foundations of its enterprise technology business.”
The group is generating more cash while spending less on capital investment. Capital expenditure fell by 22.5% to R2.2 billion ($130 million), reflecting selective fibre investment and the modernisation and optimisation of its mobile network. Free cash flow increased from R724 million ($42.7 million) to R998 million ($58.8 million).
Telkom expects investment to increase in the second half, focusing on network modernisation, customer experience and opportunities supported by identifiable demand.
The improved performance gives Telkom a stronger financial footing as it enters a pivotal period. Its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio stood at 0.6 times, within its medium-term guidance range, while profit for the period increased by 10.8% to R1.8 billion ($106 million).
“The next phase of Telkom’s transformation is not simply about proving that our business can withstand a changing market. It is about demonstrating that we can consistently convert our customer relationships, infrastructure and capabilities into sustainable earnings, cash generation and long-term value,” Taukobong said.

articles.title: La Ley de Propiedad Horizontal lo confirma: si un vecino no paga, los propietarios podrían apelar al artículo 21
articles.text:
Cuando un vecino de tu edificio deja de pagar sus cuotas, la comunidad de propietarios tiene un camino marcado en el artículo 21 de la Ley de Propiedad Horizontal. Esta ley permite que la comunidad pueda reclamar la deuda por vía judicial e incluso llegar al embargo.
Lo que dice el artículo 21. El precepto regula el impago de los gastos comunes, las medidas que puede pactar la comunidad, la reclamación judicial y la mediación o el arbitraje, y buena parte de ese contenido se incorporó con la Ley 10/2022. Y es que fue esa reforma la que permitió a la junta aprobar medidas disuasorias contra los morosos, siempre que no sean abusivas ni afecten a la habitabilidad.
La obligación de pagar está en el artículo 9.1.e de la Ley de Propiedad Horizontal, y para reclamar lo que se debe la comunidad puede tirar del proceso monitorio especial, sin que el artículo 21 fije un importe máximo.
Sin voto mientras haya deuda. ¿Y qué pasa en las juntas? Pues que, según el artículo 15.2, quien no esté al corriente de sus deudas al empezar la reunión puede participar en las deliberaciones, pero no votar, salvo que las haya impugnado judicialmente o haya consignado lo que debe. Además, el artículo 16.2 obliga a que la convocatoria incluya la relación de propietarios que no están al corriente de pago.
Vamos, que dentro de la comunidad sí puede saberse quién debe, aunque con cuidado. También se puede crear una lista de deudores en el tablón de anuncios de la comunidad, aunque la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos lo admite solo cuando se puedan acreditar intentos fallidos de notificar al propietario.
Del burofax al embargo. La reclamación arranca con un acuerdo de la junta que liquida la deuda y que se notifica al vecino por un medio que deje constancia de la recepción, para lo que la Organización de Consumidores y Usuarios (OCU) recomienda el burofax.
Si el vecino se opone al monitorio, que es el proceso judicial rápido para cobrar deudas claras sin pasar por un juicio completo, la comunidad puede pedir el embargo preventivo de bienes suficientes, que el juzgado acuerda sin exigirle caución, y la misma OCU apunta que puede alcanzar al propio inmueble del moroso. A la deuda se le pueden sumar además intereses, ya que la junta puede fijarlos por encima del interés legal mientras dure el impago.

Sennheiser suit Sony et Bowers & Wilkins en dégainant cette année son meilleur casque Bluetooth à réduction de bruit active, le Momentum 4 Wireless. Avec ses nouveautés, ce nouveau venu se propulse de justesse dans l'élite du marché.

articles.title: How one malfunctioning router in Arkansas grounded every flight in America last week
articles.text:
What we know so far: The nationwide ground stop that froze US air travel on Friday didn't start at a major hub or a busy control center. It began at a small FAA radio site in El Dorado, Arkansas, where a router installed during routine upgrade work began flooding the agency's private network with connection requests that the older equipment it connected to couldn't handle. Soon after, the links between pilots and controllers and the radar feeds that track aircraft started failing.
The result was more than 3,500 flights held for about five hours, leaving tens of thousands of travelers stranded.
The volume of traffic was far beyond anything the network normally handles. "We saw two places that were actually pinging our network at a very high rate, a thousand connections over every four to five seconds," Rebecca Guy, the FAA's technology chief, said on Saturday at a press conference.
El Dorado was one of those two places. The other was a radar facility in Amarillo, Texas, which had been upgraded several weeks earlier and showed a second problem that officials have not described. Engineers took both sites offline, but by then each had been hitting the network hundreds of times per second. That was enough to knock out other parts of the air traffic communications system, and the delays and cancellations carried into the weekend.
The Arkansas work was part of a long-running FAA effort to move its telecommunications from old copper wiring to fiber-optic cable. L3Harris, which owns and operates the network, has worked with the FAA on modernization for more than two decades and says it has finished more than 70% of the planned conversion. Crews chose to work on the El Dorado station because it seemed remote enough that a problem there would cause little harm, an assumption that turned out to be wrong.
The hardware involved is not the kind of router found in a home office. The FAA runs tens of thousands of these networking devices, including routers and switches, and they are larger, industrial-grade units built for harsh environments, Michael McCormick, a professor at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in Daytona Beach, Florida, told The New York Times.
They sit on a closed network meant to keep out cyberattacks. They also have to read and process radar data, flight plans and audio, then send each piece to the right place. The agency's equipment comes from Cisco Systems and Juniper Networks, which Hewlett Packard Enterprise bought last year, and the FAA has been slowly swapping older Cisco routers for newer Juniper models.
Aviation experts think the failure came from a speed mismatch. A new device that pushes out data faster than older equipment can answer can stall the older gear, and the trouble spreads from there. R. John Hansman, a professor of aeronautics and astronautics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, said the new equipment pushed older parts of the network beyond their usual pace. "Now you have multiple parts of the old system that are running much faster than they ever ran," he said. "You never had this problem, because you never had all of the elements running at that max speed."
When the network began to falter, McCormick said, it became "unpredictable and unreliable," and stopping departures was the right decision. "It was a smart decision to actually decide to ground-stop all air departures," he said.
Investigators are now trying to determine whether the router was defective or whether something went wrong during installation. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the problem on Sunday during an appearance on Face the Nation. "We actually have both routers with L3Harris, who operates and owns our network. FAA is on site as well. FBI is offering support. We're looking at that right now, and when we know what the root cause of this issue was, was it the install from L3Harris? Was it the router?" he said. "I'm going to tell you and the American people what we find."
The FAA says it has found no evidence of a cyberattack. L3Harris said it is helping with the investigation.
Not everyone accepts the official explanation. Robert W. Mann Jr., who founded an airline analysis and consulting firm, doubted that one device could cause this much damage. "The idea that you would have a single router take down a national network is just not plausible," he said. He saw the outage as evidence of a long-known weakness. "What we really have here is a demonstration that what we knew a decade ago was problematic done at small scale is really, really problematic done at nationwide scale."
The episode raises questions about redundancy in a system where trouble at one small facility could stop flights nationwide. Duffy and other officials blamed the aging infrastructure and said Congress needs to provide more money for upgrades. Experts warned that speeding up the work brings its own risks, since the legacy network must stay in service while new equipment is installed and fully tested. Some suggested doing hardware and software changes during night shifts, when far fewer planes are flying, rather than during busy daytime hours.

articles.title: GitHub Rebuilds the Copilot App's Diff Surface to Open Million-Line Pull Requests Without Jank
articles.text:
GitHub engineering has published a detailed account of how it rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a pull request with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines and more than 400 inline review comments without turning the review into a waiting exercise.
The post, by Principal Design Engineer Alberto Gimeno, lands at a moment when AI coding agents are producing far more pull requests than reviewers can digest, and the bottleneck has moved from writing code to reading it.
At the heart of the rebuild is a decision to stop pretending a pull request is a single uniform list. Code rows have a known height at a known font size, so their geometry can be computed up front and never rebuilt. Comments do not. A markdown body wraps differently at different widths, <details> sections can be toggled in place, reply composers grow as a user types, and images change height when they load. Rather than force one variable-height virtualizer to absorb both, the team split the document into two independent domains:
total height = deterministic code height
 + Σ dynamic block effective heights
 + scroll padding
Dynamic blocks are keyed by identity (file, line, side) rather than pixel position, with a fingerprint tracking content, open state and measurement width. A single idle-gated measurement pass reads mounted blocks in one batch, scoped to roughly 2,400 pixels around the viewport, and corrections are anchored to whatever the reader is looking at so the surface never fights an active scroll.
Gimeno is open about an early mistake, the team's first instinct was one ResizeObserver per block writing heights back into the layout, a classic feedback loop whose cost grows with every mounted block. The shipped design keeps the observer but defaults it to flagging rather than writing, with a deliberate frame-synchronous exception when the user toggles a <details> or expands a reply composer, so the code below moves in the same frame.
The work builds on an April 2026 post from the main github.com files-changed team, who reported that unified-view diff lines previously rendered as roughly eight React components and ten DOM elements each, and cut both roughly in half.
GitHub's own stacked pull requests went into public preview on 30 July 2026 as an explicit answer to AI-generated monsters, and a DEV Community piece cited Microsoft research finding review quality degrades sharply once a pull request exceeds roughly 200 lines, a rounding error against the Copilot app's million-line test case.
Third-party tools have filled the gap from the review side. Graphite, Pullfrog and CodeRabbit each take different runs at agent-era review, with Codegen CEO Jay Hack arguing that the winners in this new era will be the teams that redesign their workflows around the fact that review, not code, is now the bottleneck.
The team also describes the measurement loop built around the rebuild. The surface carries permanent structured probes for its own invariants, which run as CI budgets against a synthetic huge-pull-request fixture, and an autopilot drives the real desktop app through a scripted flow, cold and warm, so an agent can read the on-disk log and spot regressions without anyone at the keyboard. Gimeno's closing line is addressed to anyone who reviews code for a living: open the worst pull request you have got.

articles.title: Jensen Huang allies build a "war room" to get him back at Nvidia
articles.text:
Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia’s chief executive, as allies in Silicon Valley pressure the company’s board to reinstate him days after the tech executive resigned over reports he had affairs with a suspected Chinese spy and a subordinate.
Huang has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning, according to multiple people familiar with the matter—even as an independent probe by Nvidia’s board investigates the conduct that led to a spectacular leadership crisis at the $4 trillion chip company this week.
One Huang ally told the FT they were putting together a “war room” of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for the former Nvidia chief’s return and would try to garner support from the White House.
“Everyone that matters in tech outside the frontier labs loves Jensen,” they said. The efforts had Huang’s support, they added.
A public campaign to reinstate Huang has gathered steam over the weekend. Tesla and SpaceX chief Elon Musk and Epic Games chief executive Tim Sweeney were among executives backing a public letter demanding that its board “Bring Jensen Back.”
Huang continues to command fierce loyalty from some employees, several of whom have gone public in calling for his return in the days since he resigned and have signed the open letter.

articles.title: Samsung pode deixar câmera com abertura variável para o Galaxy S28 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Samsung pode deixar câmera com abertura variável para o Galaxy S28
Recurso chegou a ser cogitado para o Galaxy S27, mas custo pode empurrar retorno para 2028.
A Apple trouxe para o iPhone 18 Pro a câmera principal com abertura variável pela primeira vez e o movimento reacendeu rumores de que a Samsung faria o mesmo no próximo flagship. Especulava-se que já veríamos o retorno da tecnologia na sul-coreana no ano que vem, agora, porém, podemos ter de esperar até o Galaxy S28.
Segundo o informante Yogesh Brar, a fabricante trabalha para levar a lente com abertura variável aos modelos Galaxy S28 Pro e Galaxy S28 Ultra, em 2028. Os planos teriam mudado devido ao custo do componente e ao espaço adicional necessário dentro do smartphone.
Como ainda falta mais de um ano para a possível estreia dos aparelhos, o site Android Authority ressalta que os planos podem mudar durante o desenvolvimento.
A fabricante adotou uma câmera com abertura física ajustável no Galaxy S9, em 2018, e só a manteve na família até a geração seguinte. Na época, um pequeno mecanismo permitia alternar entre duas aberturas, melhorando ajustes como a exposição e profundidade de campo.
Uma permite maior permite que mais luz chegue ao sensor, algo útil especialmente em ambientes escuros, enquanto a abertura mais fechada reduz a quantidade de luz e aumenta a região da imagem que permanece em foco.
O mecanismo desapareceu da linha mais cara da marca a partir do Galaxy S20, em 2020. O motivo teria sido o mesmo do adiamento atual: reduzir custos de produção e o espaço físico ocupado pelo conjunto.
A possibilidade de uma câmera com abertura variável voltar aos Galaxy começou a ganhar força após relatos de que a empresa havia procurado fornecedores para desenvolver novos módulos. Segundo informações anteriores, a fabricante avaliava a tecnologia como uma forma de melhorar a competitividade das câmeras dos celulares mais avançados, avanço que tem sido exigido pelo público da Samsung nos últimos modelos.
A expectativa inicial era que o trabalho resultasse em um componente pronto para o Galaxy S27, mas, de acordo com Brar, incorporar o sistema elevaria o custo de fabricação. A companhia já tem elevado o preço final dos aparelhos continuamente devido a crise de componentes de memória.
Brar afirma ainda que a Samsung não é a única fabricante estudando esse tipo de solução para futuros celulares de alto desempenho. O possível retorno acompanha a aparição da tecnologia em smartphones avançados de outras marcas.
A Apple adotou o recurso na câmera principal da linha iPhone 18 Pro, seguindo a Huawei, que trouxe a abertura variável no Pura 80 Ultra — ambos disponíveis no Brasil, por preços a partir de R$ 11.999 e 12.999, respectivamente.
As primeiras informações sobre a família Galaxy S28 já começaram a aparecer mesmo antes do lançamento do Galaxy S27, previsto para o primeiro semestre do ano que vem. Rumores passados da cadeia de suprimentos já nos dão sinais ao menos sobre o chip que o aparelho deve carregar.
Segundo o ZDNet Korea, a Samsung desenvolve o Exynos 2800, previsto para a geração de 2028. Os vazamentos apontam que, em vez de migrar imediatamente para um processo de 1,4 nanômetro, a Samsung estaria planejando continuar refinando sua tecnologia de 2 nm para o Exynos 2800.
A intenção seria priorizar a estabilidade da produção e evitar problemas de aquecimento enfrentados por gerações anteriores da família Exynos.

articles.title: ASUS Republic of Gamers Unveils the ROG Harpe II Ace Mini and Special Demon1 Edition
articles.text:
Monday, November 16th 2026
ASUS Republic of Gamers Unveils the ROG Harpe II Ace Mini and Special Demon1 Edition
ASUS Republic of Gamers (ROG) today unveiled the ROG Harpe II Ace Mini, an ultralight 47-gram esports gaming mouse developed through sports-science research and extensive collaboration with professional players. The mouse combines a compact, pro-refined design with next-generation wireless technology for competitive FPS gaming.
As part of its continued commitment to developing Ace esports hardware alongside professional players, ROG worked closely with VALORANT World Champion Maximilian "Demon1" Mazanov throughout the development of the Harpe II Ace Mini. His direct involvement, alongside feedback from other professional players, helped shape the compact, semi-symmetrical design built for the demands of competitive play. The collaboration also introduces the Harpe II Ace Mini Demon1 Edition, a special colorway that brings the champion's personal style to the same performance-focused hardware.Shaped by champions, backed by science
At the heart of the ROG Harpe II Ace Mini is a development process that brings together sports-science research and firsthand insights from professional esports players.
From early prototypes to the final design, Demon1 played an active role in evaluating and refining the mouse, providing feedback based on his experience competing at the highest level of VALORANT. Insights gathered through extensive testing with Demon1 and other professional players helped ROG refine the mouse's shape and handling characteristics to meet the demands of competitive gaming. 
The resulting compact, semi-symmetrical shape is designed to accommodate greater fingertip mobility, allowing claw and fingertip grip users to make precise micro-adjustments without relying solely on wrist movements. Weighing just 47 grams, the mouse also supports quick, controlled flicks and effortless repositioning.
This collaborative development approach reflects ROG's broader commitment to working directly with esports athletes to understand their needs and translate their experience into meaningful product design.
Demon1, VALORANT Champions 2023 winner"Working with ASUS ROG on the Harpe II Ace Mini has been a great experience because I got to share what I look for in a competitive mouse, try different prototypes, and see how my feedback helped shape the final design. Seeing it all come together has been really exciting, and the final mouse is exactly what I was looking for. It's honestly the perfect mouse for me,"
ROG Harpe II Ace Mini Demon1 Edition: Respect the Name
Making his debut in 2023, Demon1 quickly established himself as one of VALORANT's standout competitors. In his rookie VCT season, he helped Evil Geniuses reach the Masters Tokyo Grand Final before claiming the VALORANT Champions 2023 title. His exceptional performance at Champions, including a then-record 101 kills in the Grand Final, earned him the tournament MVP award. His achievements were further recognized with the 2023 Esports Breakthrough Player of the Year award.
Building on his involvement in developing the Harpe II Ace Mini, ROG introduces the Harpe II Ace Mini Demon1 Edition, a special colorway that celebrates his personal style.
Featuring an exclusive gradient lilac finish and Demon1's signature, the mouse combines a distinctive appearance with the same performance-focused design and hardware as the standard Harpe II Ace Mini. The accompanying receiver features a matching case and exclusive cat-themed stickers, adding another personal touch to this special collaboration. 
More than a signature product, the Demon1 Edition represents the close collaboration between ROG and professional players, bringing a world champion's preferences and competitive experience into a mouse available to FPS enthusiasts.
Precision and performance for competitive play 
Beyond its player-refined shape, the ROG Harpe II Ace Mini features advanced technologies designed to deliver responsive and reliable performance in competitive gaming.
Powered by ROG SpeedNova 8K Gen II wireless technology, the mouse supports true 8000 Hz wireless polling and features an enhanced receiver to improve wireless signal quality. The new RF architecture uses Active Dynamic Hopping to scan for optimal channels and help minimize interference, while Smart RF Detection provides real-time feedback on surrounding wireless conditions. Dual customizable LED indicators allow players to monitor RF status, battery level, and active profiles at a glance.
The ROG AimPoint Pro 65K optical sensor is designed to capture rapid movements and precise adjustments with exceptional responsiveness, offering up to 65,000dpi sensitivity, a scanning rate of up to 20,000 FPS (frames per second), and 11 selectable LoD (lift-off-distance) settings for fine-tuned tracking. Meanwhile, ROG optical micro switches provide swift actuation and a lifespan of 100 million clicks. Each mouse undergoes individual machine testing to ensure that click-force consistency between its left and right buttons. 
For competitive gaming environments, Zone Mode enables optimized hardware settings, including polling rate, sensor responsiveness, and control over wireless transmission strength. 
For convenient setup across practice rooms, tournament PCs, and shared systems, players can customize essential mouse settings directly through a browser using ROG Gear Link, without downloading additional software. A dedicated carry case is included to safely store the mouse and accessories when traveling between practice sessions, bootcamps, and tournaments.

articles.title: Tesla goes all-in on the Cybercab with upcoming €3B Berlin gigafactory expansion | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Just two months after putting its first Cybercabs on the road, Tesla is making a multibillion-dollar bet on mass production of the golden-hued, two-seat autonomous vehicles.
The company announced Monday that it will spend €3 billion ($3.3 billion) to expand its Berlin gigafactory, with plans to begin building Cybercabs there in 2029. The new building in Grünheide, just east of Berlin, will be capable of producing up to 1 million vehicles per year, André Thierig, Tesla’s senior director of manufacturing for the site, wrote on LinkedIn.
Construction is expected to begin in the first half of 2027. The expansion will make the facility the most technologically advanced of all Tesla factories, Thierig added.
Tesla has been directing more resources toward the Cybercab project, a reflection of its mission to become an AI and robotics company, rather than just an automaker.
The company has already announced plans to cease production of the Cybertruck next year, in part to make room for Cybercab manufacturing at its factory in Austin, Texas.
Musk doesn’t see much of a future for drive-it-yourself EVs even though demand for the Model 3 and Model Y has remained strong despite flagging U.S. sales. The company delivered more than 486,000 vehicles in the third quarter, about 6,000 more than the second quarter. Sales in Europe have been rising as EV adoption continues apace.
Musk has been far more interested in pushing the company toward fully automated driving systems that don’t require a human driver to pay attention — unlike the company’s current advanced driver assistance system, known as Full Self-Driving (Supervised).
The steering wheel-free Cybercab, which was first revealed in 2024 and launched publicly in September, is the current centerpiece of that plan. It’s notable for its lack of a steering wheel, pedals, and other traditional motor vehicle equipment, some of which is required under federal safety standards. (Federal regulators are currently investigating Tesla’s self-certification of the vehicle.)
Tesla’s approach to self-driving systems differs from that of competitors such as Waymo. Tesla relies solely on cameras, rather than additional other sensors such as lidar, to help provide its self-driving system the means to understand its environment. Camera data mimics human vision, but without sufficient training, AI models can struggle to interpret situations that additional sensor data might help clarify.
Tesla has so far taken a slow approach to its Cybercab rollout. The vehicles have been restricted from driving late at night, though Tesla has been working to extend their operating hours. In the more than two months that Cybercabs have been operating, they haven’t had any major incidents.
That track record appears to have given Tesla enough confidence to commit significant resources to expanding Cybercab production and availability. Tesla has about 1,307 robotaxis registered in Texas. Most are modified Model Y vehicles that are used in robotaxi services in several Texas cities. But the Cybercab numbers are growing with about 573 on roads in Austin and soon Dallas.
Now, Europe is firmly on its roadmap, too.

articles.title: Microsoft aclara uno de los mayores misterios de Windows cuando el rendimiento se desploma
articles.text:
Microsoft ha explicado por qué el truco más obvio para acelerar Windows no funciona. Cuando el sistema operativo se vuelve lento o deja de responder, muchos recurren al Administrador de tareas para identificar el problema y cerrar el proceso responsable. No obstante, existen situaciones en donde el propio Administrador y la barra de tareas dejan de responder cuando más se necesitan.
Debido a ello, muchos se preguntan por qué Microsoft no asigna una prioridad más alta a estos procesos. Al ejecutarse con más privilegios, seguirían funcionando sin problemas, incluso cuando el procesador se satura y el ordenador deja de responder. Lamentablemente para los usuarios de Windows, el problema es más complejo de lo que parece y un cambio de prioridades no lo resolvería.
Raymond Chen, un ingeniero veterano de Microsoft que fue pieza clave de Windows 95 y el desarrollo de la interfaz de usuario, reveló que aumentar la prioridad de un proceso permite que obtenga tiempo de CPU antes que otros procesos menos importantes. El problema es que esto no siempre funciona, ya que el problema aparece cuando una aplicación se acaba los recursos compartidos.
Según Chen, tener prioridad alta es como tener un pase preferente en la fila del supermercado. Puedes avanzar hasta el frente más rápido que los demás clientes, pero si la persona que está siendo atendida tiene un carrito lleno de productos, tendrás que esperar a que termine.
El problema no termina ahí, ya que hay veces en las que el proceso que se acaba los recursos compartidos está realizando tareas lentas. En estos casos, aunque Windows cuente con mecanismos para mitigar los problemas con las prioridades de los procesos, estos no pueden eliminar el tiempo de espera para que el recurso quede libre.
La interfaz gráfica de Windows es su talón de Aquiles
Raymond Chen fue un paso más lejos y añadió que la interfaz gráfica de Windows añade más complejidad al problema de ordenadores que se cuelgan. Tanto el Administrador de tareas como la barra de tareas dependen del sistema de interfaz de usuario de Windows, por lo que tarde o temprano competirán por recursos con otros procesos de esta categoría que se encuentran activos.
"El problema es que es difícil arreglar un sistema descontrolado desde dentro de ese mismo sistema", dijo el ingeniero de Microsoft. "Las herramientas que puedes usar para intentar arreglar el sistema pueden que ya hayan sido comprometidas. Y desde luego es difícil arreglar un sistema descontrolado si tus herramientas tienen que compartir recursos críticos con aquello que está fuera de control".
El veterano de Microsoft mencionó que Windows ya ofrece trato preferencial a las aplicaciones que se encuentran en el primer plano. Si el usuario consigue que el sistema se enfoque en el Administrador de tareas o la barra, Windows le dará prioridad a la ejecución, siempre y cuando no haya procesos que acaparen todo el rendimiento compartido.
En pocas palabras, el Administrador de tareas no siempre es la mejor opción cuando el equipo ya no responde. En estos casos, la solución es esperar algunos minutos a que se estabilice el proceso o de plano hacer un reinicio manual si Windows se queda colgado.

articles.title: Apple TV 4K (4th Gen) review - adds intelligence and convenience to a high quality viewing experience - Tech Guide
articles.text:
- RATING
The new Apple TV 4K is an impressive improvement to not only offer higher-quality viewing but also more intelligence and convenience to make it an all-round better experience.
It’s been 4 years since the release of the previous Apple TV 4K and in that time Apple has made several smart improvements that improve and enrich the home viewing experience.
The last time Apple released Apple TV 4K was in November 2022 and it was powered by the A15 Bionic chip. Siri AI, and Apple Intelligence were maybe in the planning stages.
The new Apple TV 4K (4th gen) is powered by the A19 chip which makes it 50 per cent faster in CPU performance and 2x faster in GPU performance than the previous model.
If you are an avid user of Apple TV 4K like we are, you will notice the improvement.
And if you’re deep in the Apple ecosystem then the Apple TV 4K would be a suitable product to enjoy your streaming services and entertainment.
A lot of people might be asking, “Why do I need this if I can access all the apps, including Apple TV, on my new smart TV?”
It’s literally about context. Your personal context, to be precise.
When Apple TV 4K is on the same network as your iPhone and iPad it knows you and what you like and what has been recommended to you.
Siri AI on Apple TV 4K uses natural language understanding and has broad world knowledge.
You can talk to it like you would the Siri AI assistant on your other Apple devices.
This new model has far-field microphones so even from across the room Siri will hear you when you want to search, play and control what you’re watching.
And these microphones are sensitive enough to hear you say “Siri “or “Hey Siri” even while audio is playing.
It has the same silicon built into the iPhone and runs tvOS and is a great example of Apple hardware, software and services running perfectly together.
Setting up the new Apple TV 4K was a breeze.
All we had to do was bring our iPhone close to Apple TV for it to begin transferring our preferences and credentials, including our Wi-Fi network, Apple account, and other device settings.
In fact during setup, it asked us if we wanted to copy another Apple TV 4K already running in the house. It’s located in our home theatre.
We agreed and minutes later every app that was on the other Apple TV 4K was now downloaded and ready on the new one.
One of the most attractive features for us was the high performance of Apple TV 4K.
We have it in our home theatre and naturally we want to produce the best results.
Under the hood is a 4K scaler that can upscale content to look near 4K quality it also outputs the highest resolution to your TV. In our case it was to our projector via our receiver.
Apple TV 4K also supports both Dolby Vision and HDR10+, two of the most popular and dynamic HDR formats.
Also supports Dolby Atmos make it an even more immersive surround sound experience.
But those who don’t have an elaborate home theatre setup like we do can still enjoy great sound by grouping HomePod speakers to create a surround sound effect.
Apple TV 4K allows users to connect up to four HomePod mini (2nd gen) and HomePod (2nd gen).
Speakers will then work together to provide perfectly synced surround sound experience that will work when watching movies and listening to music.
Apple TV also makes it easier to find content thanks to Siri AI.
You’ll be able to find messages and emails where people have recommended programmes and movies.
For example you’ll be able to say, “Hey Siri, play the trailer for that movie Jo texted me about.”
Or “Hey Siri, what episode did my brother say he loved?”
There’s a section called “Shared with you” and this brings together all the recommendations by family and friends shared through messages.
You can also ask about what TV shows and movies are trending or find other content that you’re in the mood for.
Siri has a deep knowledge of movies and TV shows and can show remarkable search results whether it’s searching for a specific production studio, actor or director.
And Siri also has contextual awareness so you can ask questions about what you’re watching like “is this show based on real people”, “is there another season coming” and “where was this filmed?”
One thing about the Apple TV hub integration is that it doesn’t include Netflix – one of the most popular streaming apps you’ll see on the platform.
So this means it won’t integrate into Apple TV’s Continue Watching, universal search, or Siri voice search.
Naturally you can still watch Netflix on Apple TV and search for it but it won’t automatically route or track playback.
The Siri remote has a one-piece aluminium design and makes it easier to navigate the system and find what you’re looking for.
The surface is also touch-enabled so it can respond to swipes and gestures. This takes a little bit of getting used to for those new to Apple TV as there may be an accidental swipe or press in the process.
And if you misplace it, you can find it with the Find My app on your iPhone.
Apple TV 4K includes all your favourite services, including Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Netflix, Paramount+.
And Apple TV, of course.
And if you’re a sports fan, Apple TV also offers F1, MLB and MLS.
Apple TV 4K also offers Apple Arcade to play the latest games with the whole family. It also supports PlayStation, Xbox, and MFI controllers.
You can also enjoy Apple Fitness to turn your home into a fitness centre and sync your Apple Watch so you can see in-session metrics like your heart rate and calories burned displayed on your TV.
Apple TV also feeds into HomeKit, so you’re able to monitor and control compatible smart home devices and even see live security camera feeds on your screen.
Apple TV 4K is available now with a 128GB capacity and is priced at $449.
VERDICT
The new Apple TV 4K is an impressive improvement to not only offer higher-quality viewing but also more intelligence and convenience to make it an all-round better experience.

articles.title: SA crypto platform OVEX deploys AI fraud detection system built by DataProphet - Disrupt Africa
articles.text:
South African crypto platform OVEX has gone live with a custom AI fraud detection system, built by machine learning consultancy DataProphet, that catches 98 per cent of fraudsters in testing.
Founded in 2017, OVEX offers South Africa’s largest selection of digital asset markets, and has partnered with several leading cryptocurrency companies and firms, including Invictus Capital, Hyperion, and TrueUSD.
DataProphet, meanwhile, was formed in 2014, and builds and runs custom machine learning for financial services, manufacturing, and other businesses. The two companies began working together back in April to replace OVEX’s rules-based fraud system with AI that learns how fraudsters behave.
Rather than judging an account from a snapshot, the system reads a user’s full activity history in sequence, including every login, deposit, trade and withdrawal. Two models, one trained on fraudulent behaviour and one on honest customers, assess which pattern each account more closely resembles. Accounts that lean towards the fraud model are flagged for investigation.
By late July, the model was catching 98 per cent of fraudsters in testing, compared with 75 per cent for the old system, and flagged 100 per cent of fraud cases it had never seen before. OVEX expects 99 per cent fewer false alarms and a 92 per cent reduction in undetected fraud. The platform also includes a tool showing investigators when an account’s behaviour turned suspicious, and a dashboard for retraining models.
“We partnered with DataProphet for their deep machine-learning expertise and they’ve built a system tailored to our platform, giving us a far more sophisticated way to identify fraud as it evolves,” said Jonathan Ovadia, chief executive of OVEX.
“Our partnership with OVEX proves that applied AI doesn’t have to be a black box or a heavy compliance burden,” said Ridwaan Seedat, CEO of DataProphet.

articles.title: Qwen4-Max : Alibaba promet une IA plus sûre, quelques semaines après un incident de données
articles.text:
Alibaba vient de lancer Qwen-4 Max, son nouveau modèle. Au programme : des coûts réduits et une sécurité améliorée.
Alibaba est bien décidé à rester dans la course à l’IA. Cet été, le géant chinois a présenté Qwen 3.8-Max en réponse à Claude Fable 5. Mais tout n’est pas rose : Bercy avait stoppé un test du modèle Qwen à cause de réponses trop orientées sur la Chine. Fin octobre, une version locale de son IA a également été surprise en train d'essayer d’envoyer des données vers Pékin. Alibaba ne baisse cependant pas les bras et lance un nouveau modèle, qui met la sécurité à l’honneur.
Alibaba dévoile son nouveau modèle, Qwen4 Max
Alibaba a lancé Qwen4-Max, un modèle fermé « basé sur la nouvelle architecture Qwen4, avec un réseau de base de 2,4 billions de paramètres, des capacités de vision intégrées et une fenêtre contextuelle d’un million de tokens ». La technologie, capable de mener seule des projets au long cours, possède de nombreuses fonctionnalités : modélisation 3D, création de jeux vidéo, conception de pièces automobiles, analyses financières, audits juridiques, aide au diagnostic médical et bien plus encore.
Qwen4-Max ne sollicite que 71 milliards de paramètres par jeton, soit un quart de moins que la génération précédente de modèles. Cela permet d’alléger la facture des utilisateurs : Alibaba affirme notamment que l’exécution d’une tâche coûte en moyenne 62 % moins cher. Un chiffre à prendre avec des pincettes puisqu’il provient de Work360, un test maison de la firme.
Face à la concurrence, Qwen4-Max obtient des résultats mitigés : il ne finit premier que dans 4 des 16 épreuves publiées dans l’annonce. S’il brille en droit, le reste de ses performances n'égale pas celles de Claude Opus 5.5.
Une sécurité vérifiée… par Alibaba
Après l’épisode des données envoyées vers Pékin, Alibaba se devait de redorer son image. Pendant son entraînement, Qwen4-Max a donc appris à écrire du code qui ne laisse pas de portes ouvertes aux pirates. Alibaba précise notamment que « concernant les critères « reconstruction du code sans indication de sécurité » et « double vérification de la fonctionnalité et des vulnérabilités » du Last Secure Code Bench, le taux de réussite de Qwen4-Max au niveau des fonctions, tant pour la fonctionnalité que pour la sécurité, est passé de 22,0 % pour la génération précédente (Qwen3.8-Max) à 31,8 %. » La part de code sans faille a donc considérablement augmenté.
Alibaba en a aussi profité pour trier ses données d’entraînement en retirant tout ce qui pourrait servir à attaquer. Pour les armes chimiques ou biologiques, les experts de la société estiment que le modèle ne peut pas aider un utilisateur mal intentionné. Hélas, ici aussi, les vérifications ont été faites en interne. Impossible de savoir si Alibaba fera un jour appel à un audit indépendant pour confirmer ces résultats.
En attendant, le géant chinois prévoit d’ores et déjà de publier en open source des versions plus légères de Qwen4. Qwen4-Max restera, quant à lui, réservé aux clients de QwenCloud et aux outils maison d’Alibaba.

articles.title: Sortie de GTA 6 en direct : toutes les informations, les astuces et les chiffres
articles.text:
Il n’y aura plus de retard. Après deux reports, GTA 6 sort officiellement ce jeudi 19 novembre 2026 à minuit. Rockstar Games commercialise enfin son nouveau blockbuster, 13 ans après GTA 5 et 8 ans après Red Dead Redemption 2. GTA 5 s’est écoulé entre-temps à près de 235 millions d’exemplaires, selon Take-Two, la maison mère de Rockstar.
Le lancement de GTA 6 devrait être décortiqué pendant des semaines. On parle d’un véritable événement culturel, qui est dans absolument toutes les bouches, des sportifs de haut niveau aux responsables politiques. Le monde va s’arrêter pendant quelques jours autour de la sortie de ce jeu vidéo.
À cette occasion, on vous propose de suivre en direct la sortie de GTA 6, avec tous les détails, les images, les vidéos, les chiffres, les astuces et les rebonds de Numerama.
Suivez le lancement de GTA 6 en direct
Pourquoi la saga Grand Theft Auto s’appelle-t-elle GTA ?
Vous vous êtes toujours demandé pourquoi GTA s’appelle GTA ? Les trois lettres renvoient à l’expression « Grand theft auto », qui désigne une infraction liée au vol d’un véhicule automobile, l’un des éléments fondamentaux du gameplay de la saga et qui incarne bien cette liberté dont peut profiter un criminel dans les différents jeux.
Le hacker de GTA 6 plaide coupable !
Trois jours avant la sortie de GTA 6, Arion Kurtaj, 21 ans, a plaidé coupable du piratage massif de Rockstar Games survenu en 2022, soit bien avant que l’on découvre les premières images officielles du jeu. Il avait d’abord été jugé inapte pour un procès classique, puis placé dans un hôpital psychiatrique sécurisé. Il s’en était également pris à d’autres grosses entreprises (Revolut, Uber). Sa peine sera connue le 23 novembre.
Une météo qui s’annonce sublime
Rockstar Games s’est associé à la chaîne de télévision américaine spécialisée The Weather Channel pour partager de nouvelles images (sublimes) de GTA 6. Elles sont centrées sur les effets météorologiques saisissants qui pourront frapper les environnements.
Comment éviter les spoilers ?
À partir de demain, jour de sortie de GTA 6 en Nouvelle-Zélande, les spoilers risquent d’inonder le web. Et comme le titre de Rockstar Games est pensé pour sa narration, il sera nécessaire de prendre des mesures pour éviter les mauvaises surprises. Suivez le guide.
Une ville aux couleurs de GTA 6
La promotion de GTA 6 est tellement gargantuesque que la ville de Miami est devenue Vice City. À deux mois du lancement, le Kaseya Center de Miami, terrain de basket du Heat, a accueilli un panneau « Welcome to Vice City » sur son toit. Autres changements : réaménagement d’une porte d’embarquement à l’aéroport international de Miami pour faire croire aux passagers qu’ils arrivent à Vice City, ou encore installation de répliques de plaques d’égout avec un faux logo municipal de Vice City.
Le trailer des préchargements
Un GTA 6 plus réaliste ?
GTA 6 pourrait être bien plus proche de Red Dead Redemption 2, avec une expérience plus réaliste et plus mature. « Le crime est un élément fondamental de GTA — du moins, ça l’a été jusqu’à présent. Nous essayons de faire en sorte de ne pas punir les gens qui jouent comme ils en ont l’habitude… mais vos actions auront un certain effet sur le déroulement de la partie », a confié Rob Nelson, co-directeur du studio Rockstar North et l’un des trois directeurs créatifs du jeu au Guardian. Il faudra notamment entretenir la relation entre Jason et Lucia.
Un record pour les précommandes
Selon le site Sensor Tower, GTA 6 serait le jeu vidéo le plus précommandé de tous les temps, avec près de 15 millions d’exemplaires (11 millions sur PS5, 3,8 sur Xbox). Cyberpunk 2077 détenait le précédent record (8 millions).
Il existe une édition collector
Rockstar Games a bien évidemment proposé une édition collector de GTA 6, vendu 400 € et sans le jeu à l’intérieur.
On y trouve :
- une figurine de Macca the Gator d’environ 15 cm, avec un compartiment caché ;
- des lunettes de soleil Oakley Frogskins ;
- une casquette New Era ;
- un sac bandoulière Leonida Keys ;
- un miroir magnétique ;
- une cuillère à cocktail ;
- un porte-clés en forme de lame de rasoir ;
- un verre à shot ;
- des pin’s dans une boîte en métal ;
- des autocollants ;
- et un poster recto verso.
Un long aperçu de 27 minutes
La plus longue vidéo officielle de GTA 6 dure 27 minutes. Elle a été diffusée fin août, d’abord sur Netflix. Elle montre plusieurs séquences de gameplay.
Une Xbox One suffit pour jouer
Si GTA 6 sort officiellement sur les nouvelles consoles, une Xbox One, machine d’ancienne génération, suffit, grâce à la technologie Xbox Cloud Gaming (il faut être propriétaire du jeu, bien sûr, et avoir un abonnement Xbox Game Pass et/ou avoir du temps de jeu, facturé 3,49 € pour 10 heures). Les paramètres graphiques seront ceux de la Xbox Series S.
Pas de 60 fps pour GTA 6…
Rockstar Games a confirmé que GTA 6 vise les 30 fps sur toutes les consoles du marché. Même la PS5 Pro à 900 € n’offrira pas un framerate à 60 fps. La console la plus puissante de Sony offrira quand même « des visuels à couper le souffle, avec une clarté améliorée grâce à la technologie PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) et des ombres tracées par rayons, disponibles uniquement sur PlayStation 5 Pro ».
Combien pèse GTA 6 ?
Mieux vaut faire de la place sur sa console avant de lancer le téléchargement. Rockstar Games prévient que le fichier de préchargement pèse jusqu’à 212 Go selon la console. Sur PS5, vous pouvez facilement ajouter un SSD additionnel. Sur Xbox, il faut passer par une carte mémoire propriétaire.
Une femme jouable pour la première fois !
Pour la première fois dans l’histoire de la saga GTA, l’un des personnages principaux jouables est une femme. Il s’agit de Lucia Caminos, qui partage l’affiche avec Jason Duval. Ensemble, ils forment un couple de criminels façon Bonnie et Clyde.
Il existe d’ailleurs une astuce pour y jouer avant…
Vous voulez jouer à GTA 6 dès ce mercredi 18 novembre à midi ? C’est possible, mais uniquement sur Xbox. Il suffit de régler sa console sur la région de la Nouvelle-Zélande pour profiter du décalage, sans aucun risque.
À quelle heure sort GTA 6 ?
Rockstar Games a opté pour un lancement régionalisé. GTA 6 sera disponible dans chaque pays à minuit, heure locale. Certaines régions, comme la Nouvelle-Zélande, y joueront donc avant les autres.
Vous pouvez déjà installer le jeu
Que vous ayez précommandé le jeu en physique ou en numérique, vous pouvez d’ores et déjà installer GTA 6 sur votre PS5 ou votre Xbox. Rockstar Games a lancé le préchargement dès le 10 novembre pour éviter les embouteillages le jour J.
Le deuxième trailer
Que contient vraiment l’édition physique ?
L’édition physique de GTA 6, que ce soit sur PS5 ou Xbox, ne contient aucun disque. À l’intérieur de la boîte, on retrouve quand même un poster au format A3 (mais sans la carte du jeu) et divers feuillets.
C’est quoi cette édition ultime au juste ?
La version Ultime de GTA 6 ajoute ces contenus, qui sont majoritairement d’ordre cosmétique :
- Collection de voitures classiques
- Grotti Cheetah (1995)
- Revolvers Hawk & Little Morgan
- Variantes d’armes personnalisées
- Style de Vice City
- Véhicules pour la planque de Jason
- Modèle rétro pour le Ganado
- Atelier de tuning Rideout Customs
- Sara’s Unisex Salon
- Shitzu Squalo
- Boutique de vêtements Stock 305
- Vapid Dominator Buggy (1967)
- Salon de tatouage Electric Fang Tattoo
- Atelier de tuning One-Eyed Willie
- Les articles du Bonheur
- Repaire des PTT Youngin$
À noter que rien ne vous empêche d’acheter le pack plus tard, facturé 20 €.
Combien ça coûte GTA 6 ?
GTA 6 coûte 79,99 € en édition standard, en version physique (sans disque, avec un code de téléchargement) comme en numérique. Une édition Ultime est également proposée à 99,99 €, exclusivement en numérique, sur le PlayStation Store et le Microsoft Store.
Le tout premier trailer
La première bande-annonce de GTA 6, publiée en décembre 2023, a dépassé les 300 millions de vues sur YouTube.
Les grandes dates de GTA 6
- 4 février 2022 : développement confirmé
- 18 septembre 2022 : grosse fuite, avec plus de 90 vidéos en ligne
- 5 décembre 2023 : première bande-annonce (également victime d’une fuite)
- 2 mai 2025 : premier report officiel, GTA 6 est décalé de l’automne 2025 au 26 mai 2026
- 6 mai 2025 : deuxième bande-annonce
- 6 novembre 2025 : deuxième report, avec la date finale du 19 novembre 2026
- 25 juin 2026 : ouverture des précommandes
- 27 août 2026 : long aperçu de 27 minutes, diffusé sur Netflix avant YouTube
- 10 novembre 2026 : lancement des préchargements
On y est !
Enfin ! C’est la semaine de sortie de GTA 6, le nouveau blockbuster qui sort ce jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5, Xbox Series S et Xbox Series X. La machine médiatique est prête à être mise en route. On risque de manger du GTA 6 pendant des semaines et des semaines, si le jeu est bel et bien à la hauteur de cet événement mondial.
GTA 6, en bref
GTA 6 est le nouveau jeu du studio Rockstar Games, connu pour les sagas GTA et Red Dead Redemption. Après deux reports (il était d’abord prévu à l’automne 2025, puis le 26 mai 2026), il sort ce jeudi 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5, Xbox Series S et Xbox Series X. Rockstar a confirmé son développement en février 2022. En septembre de la même année, plus de 90 vidéos et images du jeu en développement ont fuité en ligne. La toute première bande-annonce date de décembre 2023. Les précommandes ont été lancées le 25 juin 2026, avec deux éditions : une version standard à 79,99 € et une version ultime à 99,99 €, vendue uniquement en numérique.
Le synopsis officiel est le suivant : « Jason et Lucia ont toujours su que la vie ne leur ferait pas de cadeau. Mais lorsque les choses tournent mal, ils découvrent le côté obscur de la région la plus ensoleillée d’Amérique, et se retrouvent au cœur d’un complot criminel qui s’étend dans tout l’État de Leonida. Ils devront plus que jamais compter l’un sur l’autre pour espérer s’en sortir vivants. » GTA 6 se déroule dans l’État fictif de Leonida, inspiré de la Floride, et dans sa grande ville, Vice City, calquée sur Miami.
Si vous avez précommandé la version numérique, le préchargement est ouvert depuis le mardi 10 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series. Prévoyez de la place : selon Rockstar, le jeu peut demander jusqu’à 212 Go d’espace de stockage, selon la console.

articles.title: Pendant que Volkswagen veut fermer des usines en Allemagne, Tesla investit 3 milliards d'euros dans la sienne pour son Cybercab — Frandroid
articles.text:
Ce lundi 16 novembre, Tesla a dévoilé son projet pour son usine du Brandebourg : un nouveau bâtiment dédié à la production, plusieurs autres constructions annexes et une station d’épuration supplémentaire.
    Pour aller plus loin
J’ai visité l’usine européenne de Tesla : voici les vrais secrets de fabrication de la Model Y
            
Le constructeur compte déposer d’ici la fin de l’année la demande d’autorisation pour cette nouvelle surface, dans le prolongement du dossier déposé en 2023. Les travaux sont annoncés pour le premier semestre 2027, et les premiers Cybercab doivent sortir d’usine en 2029. L’extension de la production de cellules doit elle aussi démarrer en 2027.
Le Cybercab est un robotaxi sans volant ni pédales, pensé pour transporter des passagers sans conducteur. Aux États-Unis, quelques clients particuliers peuvent déjà le précommander. Le directeur du site, André Thierig, promet de poser « les bases de l’usine Tesla la plus avancée au monde sur le plan technologique ».
Du 10 au 30 novembre, le LUBA mini 2 AWD 1500 passe à 1 399 € au lieu de 1 899 €, support de lavage offert ! Sans fil, navigation LiDAR 360°, évitement précis des obstacles, tonte des bordures… La tonte sans effort, même pour les jardins les plus complexes.
L’investissement tombe alors que les constructeurs allemands historiques réduisent la voilure, à l’image de Volkswagen, qui a annoncé fin août la fermeture programmée de quatre usines en Allemagne d’ici 2030. De quoi rendre ce chantier d’autant plus bienvenu pour l’industrie outre-Rhin.
Une usine qui n’a jamais vraiment rempli tous ses murs
L’usine de Grünheide, ouverte en mars 2022 (non sans mal), peut produire environ 375 000 véhicules par an. L’an dernier, il en est sorti à peu près 200 000, tous des Model Y. La cadence actuelle est d’environ 7 000 voitures par semaine, pour une limite technique de 7 500. C’est mieux qu’en 2024 et 2025, quand la crise des ventes avait suspendu les projets d’agrandissement, mais cela reste loin du plafond.
Le nouveau hall est dimensionné pour produire « jusqu’à un million » de Cybercab par an. Ce chiffre est un plafond de capacité, sans objectif de production annoncé, et il représente cinq fois la production annuelle de Model Y du site. Les effectifs suivent la reprise : ils sont repassés de 11 000 à 12 600 salariés.
Les besoins à long terme de ce nouveau bâtiment ne sont pas chiffrés, et l’annonce ne dit rien de l’homologation en Europe d’un véhicule sans volant car oui, rappelons-le, le Cybercab est un robotaxi sans volant ni pédale et donc, par conséquent, homologuable en petite série uniquement, avec un plafond de 1 500 immatriculations par type et par an dans toute l’Union.
Interrogé sur ce point, André Thierig a répondu que l’homologation ne relevait pas de Tesla, mais que le constructeur voulait avoir le bon produit au bon moment. Mais en annonçant un tel investissement, Elon Musk entend peut-être taper un coup dans la fourmilière et accélérer la législation à ce niveau, même si l’Europe est connue pour son inertie et sa lourdeur administrative. Peut-être aussi compte-t-il y intégrer un volant et des pédales pour en faire la fameuse « Model 2 » que nous n’avons jamais eue ?
Trois étapes, et encore des questions environnementales
Le projet est découpé en trois autorisations partielles. La première, accordée en octobre 2024 par l’office régional de l’environnement, couvrait la modernisation de la parcelle existante et de nouvelles zones de stockage et de logistique. La deuxième concerne la construction de ce second hall de production. La troisième couvrira notamment l’équipement de l’usine et une gare de fret sur le site.
L’eau reste le point sensible depuis l’arrivée de Tesla à Grünheide. Selon plusieurs médias allemands, le nouveau bâtiment et les embauches consommeraient davantage d’eau au total. Mais le circuit de traitement interne éviterait de produire des eaux usées sanitaires supplémentaires.
Tesla a donc obtenu un accueil favorable du gouvernement régional, mais la demande d’autorisation pour le nouveau hall n’est pas encore déposée, et la production du Cybercab ne démarrera pas avant 2029. Et quand on connaît le respect des dates et du calendrier chez Tesla, on pense évidemment qu’il faudra sans doute un peu plus de temps.
