articles.title: Beast Games World Champions vuelve con nueva temporada: cuándo y dónde verla sin XUPER TV
articles.text:
Prime Video confirmó la fecha en la que los espectadores podrán ver la tercera temporada de Beast Games, el reality de MrBeast. La nueva entrega, titulada Beast Games: World Champions, llegará a la plataforma de streaming el 16 de diciembre con sus primeros tres episodios.
El anuncio se realizó durante TwitchCon, en San Diego, California, en el marco de la presentación especial “Prime Video Presents Beast Games Live!”, conducida por Jeff Allen, ganador de la primera temporada del programa. Junto con la fecha, la plataforma difundió el primer adelanto de la competencia.
Dónde y cuándo ver la nueva temporada
Beast Games: World Champions se estrenará de forma exclusiva en Prime Video el 16 de diciembre de 2026. Ese día se publicarán los tres episodios iniciales de la temporada, por lo que será el método más seguro para disfrutar de este contenido sin recurrir a plataformas como Xuper TV.
A partir de entonces, la plataforma liberará dos capítulos por semana hasta llegar al final, previsto para el 13 de enero de 2027, cuando se emitirá el episodio de cierre con la definición del campeón.
La serie estará disponible en más de 240 países y territorios, la misma cobertura internacional con la que Prime Video distribuyó las temporadas anteriores del reality creado por Jimmy Donaldson, el nombre real de MrBeast.
De qué trata Beast Games: World Champions
La tercera temporada eleva la escala del formato con una competencia que reúne a concursantes de 196 países, quienes disputarán un premio de cinco millones de dólares.
El adelanto difundido por Prime Video muestra algunos de los escenarios que formarán parte de esta edición, entre ellos el Coliseo romano y un estadio con capacidad para decenas de miles de espectadores en vivo.
De acuerdo con la descripción oficial del programa, los participantes deberán superar pruebas de fuerza, habilidad y estrategia. A esas exigencias físicas y mentales se sumarán sobornos, traiciones y giros de guion pensados para medir hasta dónde están dispuestos a llegar por un premio capaz de cambiarles la vida.
El formato introduce además una dinámica de enfrentamiento entre naciones: se formarán alianzas entre competidores de distintos países, mientras las rivalidades se plantean entre continentes completos. Al final de la competencia, una sola persona se consagrará campeona mundial de Beast Games.
Esta dimensión internacional diferencia a la tercera temporada de las dos entregas previas, en las que cientos de participantes compitieron por premios millonarios sin la estructura de representación por países que caracteriza a World Champions.
Jimmy Donaldson regresará como presentador y productor ejecutivo de la serie. A su lado estará nuevamente Tyler Conklin, cocreador del programa junto a MrBeast, quien repetirá en la dirección y compartirá las tareas de producción ejecutiva.
El equipo de producción ejecutiva se completa con Michael H. Miller, Rob Buchta, Chris Keiper, Josh Kulic, Michael Cruz y Jeff Housenbold.
Por qué no ver series ni películas en Xuper TV
Aplicaciones piratas como Magis TV, Xuper TV y Cuevana exponen a sus usuarios a riesgos de ciberseguridad que van más allá de la infracción de derechos de autor.
Según explicó Álvaro Ponce, gerente de Operaciones de Directv Colombia, a Infobae Tecno, la falta de medios de pago empuja a parte del público hacia estos servicios no autorizados.
Un análisis de la firma ESET detectó que Magis TV solicitaba permisos innecesarios para reproducir contenido, como el acceso a archivos, notificaciones y tareas en ejecución. Esas autorizaciones pueden facilitar phishing, publicidad invasiva e instalación de malware.
El riesgo crece cuando la instalación se hace mediante archivos APK de origen desconocido, sin revisiones de seguridad, lo que puede comprometer también la red Wi-Fi del hogar. Además, la Justicia argentina ordenó bloquear dominios vinculados con estas apps, y Amazon Fire TV restringió su funcionamiento.
Como alternativas legales y gratuitas existen YouTube, Pluto TV y Rakuten TV. Para Ponce, la solución también pasa por planes accesibles como Directv Flex, que combina TV en vivo con plataformas premium rotativas y admite pago en efectivo.

articles.title: Fandango says hackers stole payment card details from checkout pages
articles.text:
Ticket seller Fandango Media is notifying customers about a data breach that exposed payment card details entered on its checkout pages.
The company says the details were exposed between October 8 and 11, and it impacts customers who made purchases through its official website.
Card skimmer code injected into Fandango’s checkout page intercepted payment card details entered when placing orders, sending the data to hackers.
Fandango Media is a major U.S. online movie ticketing platform. It sells tickets through its website and app for 31,000 U.S. cinema screens, including at AMC, Regal, and Cinemark.
The company also operates the popular movie review website Rotten Tomatoes.
“Our investigation identified evidence that an unauthorized party could access payment card information associated with certain transactions on our checkout page from October 8-11, 2026,” reads the notification to customers.
“Fandango determined on October 30, 2026 that your information may have been impacted in this incident.”
The company says the following data types may have been exposed:
- Payment card number
- CVV (verification code)
- Expiration date
- Billing ZIP (postal code)
- Email address
Fandango says the incident did not expose names, government-issued identity information, Social Security Numbers (SSNs), or any other account information.
However, the information compromised in the incident could be used for unauthorized purchases on online stores.
To reduce the risk to affected customers, Fandango is offering two years of free IDX credit and dark web monitoring, as well as identity theft recovery services, with an enrollment deadline of February 13, 2027.
Fandango says it has now fixed the issue on its checkout page, investigated with outside cybersecurity specialists, and is currently unaware of any cases of fraud leveraging the stolen data.
The company has not shared the number of affected customers. BleepingComputer has contacted Fandango to learn more, and we will update this post with their response once received.
Users who bought movie tickets from Fandango during the exposure window should monitor their statements and account activity closely, and report any unauthorized purchases to their card issuer.
One way to protect payment card details is to use one-time virtual cards when making online purchases.

articles.title: Galaxy Studio : le design probable du futur casque Samsung — Frandroid
articles.text:
Le site SamMobile a publié ce lundi 16 novembre des graphismes qui montrent l’allure générale d’un futur casque sans fil de Samsung, qui pourrait s’appeler Galaxy Studio. Il s’agit d’illustrations, et non de rendus détaillés ou de photos. Elles semblent tirées de l’application compagnon et pourraient donc ne pas refléter fidèlement le produit final. Pour l’instant, Samsung n’a rien confirmé : ni le nom, ni le prix, ni la date de lancement.
    Pour aller plus loin
Quels sont les meilleurs casques audio de 2026 ? Notre sélection
            
Selon SamMobile, le casque serait présenté début 2027, aux côtés de la gamme Galaxy S27.
Le nom Galaxy Studio a d’abord été avancé en octobre par l’informateur @evowizz, qui avait déjà révélé celui des Galaxy Buds On avant leur sortie. Samsung a en outre déposé le 14 septembre une demande de marque « Galaxy Studio » aux États-Unis, pour des casques et des écouteurs. Cette demande est toujours en cours d’examen et ne garantit pas que le constructeur utilisera ce nom.
Si ce casque voit le jour, il marquera le retour de Samsung sur le segment des casques circum-auriculaires, plus de dix ans après le Level Over, son dernier modèle de ce type. Dès le début du mois d’août, des lignes de code de l’application Galaxy Wearable mentionnaient un casque développé sous le nom de code Galaxy H1. En septembre, d’autres indices trouvés dans le code de l’application évoquaient des commandes physiques et tactiles, la réduction de bruit active et un mode ambiant.
Sur le plan esthétique, la silhouette rappelle davantage celle du Sony WH-1000XM4 que celle du WH-1000XM6. Ce rapprochement repose toutefois sur des visuels non officiels.
Des boutons physiques et une zone tactile
Les visuels montrent un bouton dédié pour passer d’un mode de réduction de bruit active (ANC) à l’autre. Des boutons de volume physiques distincts semblent aussi de la partie.
Sur ces visuels, ces boutons se trouvent sous les deux oreillettes. D’après SamMobile, les coussinets intégreraient en outre une zone tactile, apparemment réservée aux commandes de lecture. Ce mélange de boutons et de tactile est désormais courant sur les casques haut de gamme.
Des oreillettes qui se replient à plat
Début novembre, le casque est passé par la FCC, l’agence américaine qui homologue les appareils sans fil, sous la référence SM-U700. Le dossier montre des oreillettes pivotantes qui permettent de ranger le casque à plat dans un sac ou une valise. Il mentionne aussi la prise en charge du Bluetooth LE et deux coloris, beige et noir. Les visuels de SamMobile montrent, eux, un modèle noir et un modèle rouge. Seul le noir figure dans les deux sources, et Samsung peut encore modifier ses coloris d’ici la présentation officielle.
Plusieurs caractéristiques restent inconnues : autonomie, poids, taille des transducteurs et codecs pris en charge. Elles permettront pourtant de situer ce casque face au Sony WH-1000XM6, vendu 449 euros, et aux AirPods Max 2, à 579 euros, déjà bien installés sur ce créneau.

articles.title: 3MTT: Nigeria earmarks $3 million to fix its jobs problem
articles.text:
When the Nigerian government launched the 3 Million Technical Talent (3MTT) programme in 2023, it sought to build a workforce that could support the country’s digital economy, fill technical skills gaps and position Nigeria as a global supplier of technology talent. The ambition was to train three million Nigerians within four years, ending in 2027, while connecting them to opportunities locally and internationally.
The programme formed part of the federal government’s wider digital economy strategy under President Bola Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda. Its October 2023 strategic blueprint identified knowledge and technical talent as essential to economic productivity, innovation and job creation.
The ambition extended beyond training. The blueprint said the government intended to retain at least 1.5 million trained professionals in Nigeria and help another 1.5 million access the global talent market, preferably through remote opportunities.
“We have set an ambitious goal to train 3 million early to mid-career technical talents over the next four years,” Bosun Tijani, Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, wrote in the blueprint.
But almost three years after its launch, the numbers show a gap between that ambition and what has been delivered. The ministry, in a statement on 11 October, seen by TechCabal, said 179,000 fellows have been trained across four cohorts and the DeepTech programme.
“Since 2023, more than 1.8 million Nigerians have registered on the 3MTT platform, and 179,000 Fellows have been trained across four cohorts and the DeepTech programme,” the statement noted.
The gap between training and employment
Counting its wider community resources and opportunities, the Nigerian government said more than 300,000 Nigerians had benefited, and that the programme had been implemented with more than 200 partner organisations across all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT).
Against 3MTT’s three-million target, the 179,000 trained fellows represent nearly 6%, while the broader 300,000 beneficiaries represent 10%, with just over a year remaining ahead of its 2027 deadline. While this does not automatically mean the programme has failed, given that the deadline has not passed, it raises questions about the pace of implementation.
The challenge extends beyond training numbers. The World Bank estimates that about 3.5 million Nigerians enter the labour market annually, intensifying the pressure on the economy to create productive employment. For 3MTT, this makes tracking fellows’ post-training outcomes particularly important: How many have secured jobs, started businesses or found paying freelance work? And, more importantly, are these opportunities generating sustainable incomes?
Without such figures, the government can demonstrate how many people it has trained but not how much the programme has contributed to improving their economic prospects.
TechCabal sought clarification from the Ministry on employment outcomes for fellows that have been trained across previous cohorts. It had not provided answers to these at press time
A shift to employment outcomes
Against this backdrop, the 11 November statement announced that the federal government had opened applications for organisations and individual experts to join the 3MTT Delivery Network, with about ₦4 billion ($2.94 million) earmarked to support verified outcomes in Cohorts 5 and 6.
The network is designed to bring together organisations and individual experts who train Nigerians in digital and technical skills. They will work with 3MTT to help fellows acquire skills that employers need and transition into jobs, freelance work or businesses.
According to the statement, the new model builds on lessons from previous cohorts and shifts the programme away from simply expanding enrolment numbers towards connecting training to verified demand. However, it did not explain what specific implementation challenges emerged from earlier cohorts, which parts of the previous delivery model fell short or how those lessons informed the new structure.
How the government wants to transform 3MTT
Under the 3MTT Delivery Network arrangement, partners can join as Enabled Delivery Partners or Funded Delivery Partners. Both categories are expected to expand the programme’s training capacity, but their responsibilities and access to funding differ.
Enabled Delivery Partners form the wider training network. They include organisations and individual experts, with or without physical training centres. They will have access to the 3MTT Talent Operating System, the National Talent Registry, information about employer skills needs, and other partner resources, including device financing where eligible.
This category of partners will gain access to 3MTT’s national training platform, where they can recruit learners, publish courses and track progress. They can also add graduates to the National Talent Registry, access information on employer skill demands and salaries, reach over 1.8 million registered learners, and tap into learning resources and device financing opportunities, subject to eligibility.
Funded Delivery Partners, on the other hand, must demonstrate demand for the talent they intend to train. This could be for vacancies within their own organisations or placements with clients. They will submit their talent requirements, participate in selecting fellows and receive funding against verified results.
This presents a better way to engage fellows beyond just training.
The funding model is structured around four milestones: learning commenced, skills verified, an economic opportunity secured and that opportunity sustained for six months. This is intended to make funding dependent on progress from training to work, rather than the number of people enrolled alone. The Delivery Network portal outlines the application and verification process.
Cohort 5, according to the announcement, is supported by the European Union and Denmark through the GIZ Digital Transformation Center Nigeria, HAUS, a Finnish public-sector training and development organisation, and ESTDEV, Estonia’s international development cooperation agency, alongside a MacArthur Foundation grant channelled through Blue Sapphire Hub.
“Reaching three million technical talents requires a delivery ecosystem that is responsive to industry demand, accessible across communities and built to scale,” Tijani said. “By tying our support to verified demand and real results, we are strengthening the connection between skills, jobs and economic opportunity, while building the talent pipeline Nigeria needs to compete in the global digital economy.”
The new structure offers a way to bring employers closer to training and give delivery partners clearer incentives to produce work-ready talent. But an important question is how many fellows are currently employed from previous cohorts, against which the new model’s performance can be measured.
3MTT still has time to pursue its ambition. But the measure of its progress must increasingly move beyond how many Nigerians register or complete training. The government must ensure that the 3MTT Delivery Network actually delivers employment outcomes.
Its challenge is no longer just expanding access to technical training. It is ensuring that the skills it produces can find paying markets, whether through salaried employment, freelance contracts or viable businesses. Tying partner funding to verified outcomes gives the programme a way to measure that transition. But the government will have to ensure measurement of evidence of fellows’ employment and income sustainability. The new model remains a promise of better outcomes rather than proof that it can deliver them.

articles.title: Tiny flaws in diamonds could unlock a quantum computing revolution
articles.text:
Tiny flaws in diamonds could unlock a quantum computing revolution
By treating qubits like individual molecules, scientists can now predict their behavior faster and more accurately
- Date:
- November 13, 2026
- Source:
- Princeton University
- Summary:
- Scientists have discovered a faster way to identify diamond-based materials that could power quantum computers and sensors at room temperature. The breakthrough has already revealed promising new quantum building blocks that could help unlock computing capabilities far beyond those of today's supercomputers.
- Share:
A new computational technique could accelerate the search for diamond materials capable of powering future quantum computers and highly sensitive sensors. Developed by a researcher at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL), the method makes it much easier to identify promising materials for quantum technology, potentially opening the door to advances across many areas of science.
The approach has already revealed new candidates for quantum computing and sensing applications. The findings were recently published in ACS Central Science and have attracted attention from other researchers in the field.
One of the biggest challenges in developing quantum technology is finding materials that can maintain delicate quantum states under practical conditions. Many candidates require extremely low temperatures to function reliably. Diamond materials stand out because certain quantum properties can remain useful even at room temperature.
This capability could help advance technologies that are important to national research priorities and the development of next-generation computing. Quantum sensors promise levels of sensitivity and precision beyond those of conventional instruments, while quantum computers could eventually solve certain extraordinarily complex problems much faster than today's most powerful supercomputers.
Why Imperfect Diamonds Could Be the Key to Quantum Computing
Although diamonds are made of carbon atoms, a flawless diamond crystal is not enough to create a useful quantum computing system. The key lies in tiny irregularities within the crystal structure.
These imperfections, known as defects, can occur when a carbon atom is absent from its normal position, when another element replaces a carbon atom, or when both changes occur together. The atoms surrounding these defects can form qubits, the basic units used to store and process quantum information in quantum computers and sensors.
Finding the most useful defects, however, has been difficult. Accurately modeling their quantum behavior traditionally requires enormous computational resources, making it challenging to evaluate large numbers of possible candidates.
A Simpler Way to Discover Better Diamond Qubits
Mark Martirez, a staff research scientist at PPPL, developed a way to dramatically reduce the complexity of these calculations. Instead of simulating a much larger diamond structure, he isolates a small region containing just 16 to 30 atoms around a defect.
By "carving out" this tiny atomic cluster and treating it like a separate molecule, Martirez can use powerful computational methods that chemists have spent decades refining. These established techniques make it possible to analyze the quantum properties of diamond defects much more efficiently without sacrificing the high level of accuracy needed for the calculations.
"Because we're treating the qubits as molecules, the cost of calculating these defects is equivalent to the cost of just modeling a simple molecule," Martirez said. "This method really opened the floodgates" in terms of how qubits can be assessed.
The new technique allows researchers to calculate how different qubits respond to laser light and microwave pulses far more quickly than before. Using this approach, the team identified promising defects involving boron and oxygen that could serve as new types of qubits.
New Diamond Defects Reveal a Spectrum of Quantum Colors
Light plays an important role in how scientists interact with diamond qubits. Researchers use lasers and microwave pulses to manipulate their quantum states and retrieve stored information.
Much of the previous work in this area has centered on a defect known as the nitrogen-vacancy center. This structure forms when a nitrogen atom takes the place of a carbon atom in a diamond crystal, while an adjacent position that would normally contain another carbon atom remains empty.
Under laser illumination, this type of defect can emit red light when it occupies a particular quantum state.
The newly investigated defects offer different optical properties. Oxygen defects can produce blue light, while those involving boron emit ultraviolet light.
These differences could make it possible to combine several types of qubits within a single quantum device. Because each type responds differently to light, researchers might be able to interact with one group of qubits without disturbing another.
"One could imagine, then, combining different qubits of different responses, so you can basically probe one qubit but not the other," Martirez said.
Beyond identifying new candidates, the findings suggest a broader change in how researchers approach quantum technology. Diamond qubits have traditionally been studied primarily through physics, but understanding their underlying chemistry could provide additional ways to design them.
Martirez believes that researchers could eventually engineer qubits for particular functions using principles similar to those applied when chemists create specialized molecules, including compounds designed for new medications.
How Quantum Chemistry Could Transform Future Research
The potential benefits extend well beyond the development of quantum computers themselves. Martirez sees an intriguing possibility in which advances made possible by quantum chemistry eventually lead to quantum technologies that help improve the field of chemistry.
In other words, quantum chemistry could develop the very tools needed to "enrich itself" in the coming decades.
A practical quantum system containing multiple qubits could make molecular calculations substantially more accurate. That would allow scientists to study increasingly complex chemical structures, including large biological molecules and proteins, with a level of detail that is difficult to achieve using conventional methods.
"We could describe larger molecules, biomolecules, proteins and everything like that in a more accurate way, and that could improve all the chemical-adjacent industries, such as pharmaceutical science and materials science. Even our fundamental understanding of molecular systems could be enriched."
Such improvements could have far-reaching implications for pharmaceutical development, materials research, and the fundamental study of how molecules behave.
Martirez also hopes the research will encourage more chemists to explore solid-state physics. Although building advanced quantum computers is often viewed as a challenge primarily for physicists, he argues that chemistry offers valuable expertise that could help accelerate progress.
"At this moment in time, there's a great emphasis on building the first state-of-the-art qubit computer," he said. "But it's not just physicists who should be participating in this research. Chemists have decades of developed intuition about chemical systems that could be easily translated into understanding defects in solids as well."
By bringing these disciplines together, scientists may be able to develop more effective ways to discover, understand, and eventually engineer the quantum materials needed for future technologies.
The research was funded through PPPL's Laboratory Directed Research and Development program under prime contract number DE-AC02-09CH11466, with additional support from the DOE Office of Science, Office of Fusion Energy Sciences.
Story Source:
Materials provided by Princeton University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
Journal Reference:
- John Mark P. Martirez. A Chemist’sGuide to Solid-State Qubits: DiamondColor Centers as Embedded Vacancy-Centered Molecules. ACS Central Science, 2026; 12 (10): 1578 DOI: 10.1021/acscentsci.6c00548

articles.title: Irene Gramage, especialista en herencias: "Si en una herencia un hermano se aprovecha, hay que hacer un requerimiento notarial"
articles.text:
Cuando varios hermanos tienen que repartirse las propiedades de sus padres y uno se instala sin el permiso de los demás en una de las viviendas, el reparto puede quedarse bloqueado y acabar en los tribunales. Irene Gramage, experta en herencias, ha explicado en un vídeo de TikTok qué se puede hacer en esa situación. “Si en una herencia un hermano se aprovecha, hay que hacer un requerimiento notarial”, asegura.
El requerimiento notarial. Gramage pone como ejemplo el caso real de unos hermanos que, después del fallecimiento de sus padres, tienen que repartir las propiedades familiares- El problema llega cuando uno de ellos se va a vivir a una de las casas y se niega a firmar los documentos necesarios para seguir adelante. Si no hay respuesta, explica la experta, el siguiente paso sería recurrir a un requerimiento notarial para intentar desbloquear el reparto.
Esta vía está recogida en el artículo 1005 del Código Civil, que permite pedir al notario que avise al heredero de que dispone de 30 días naturales para aceptar o renunciar a la herencia. Y es que quedarse callado también tiene consecuencias, porque si no contesta en ese plazo “se entenderá aceptada la herencia pura y simplemente”.
Las llaves y el alquiler. Pero el requerimiento no es la única herramienta. Según Gramage, también se puede reclamar la entrega de las llaves de la vivienda al hermano que la ocupa. “Si no entrega las llaves del inmueble tendrá que pagar un alquiler al resto de hermanos”, asegura. Eso sí, esa compensación dependerá de las circunstancias de cada caso y de lo que se determine legalmente.
Una vía judicial cara. Si aun así no se llega a un acuerdo, cualquiera de los coherederos puede solicitar la división judicial de la herencia. En ese procedimiento, regulado en la Ley de Enjuiciamiento Civil, pueden intervenir un contador-partidor y peritos que valoren los inmuebles, a lo que hay que sumar los gastos de abogados y procuradores. Vamos, que no sale barato: “Eso va a costar un pastón”, advierte Gramage.
Por eso, si eres tú quien está pensando en quedarse en una de las casas, la experta recomienda pensarse bien las consecuencias antes de ocuparla y bloquear el reparto de los bienes.

articles.title: Microsoft says Project Helix is a console that plays PC games, not a PC that plays console games
articles.text:
The takeaway: Microsoft's next-generation Xbox, code-named Project Helix, is being built as a console that can run PC games, not as a Windows PC adapted to play console titles. Jason Ronald, Xbox's vice president of next generation, made that distinction in an interview published in the company's new digital Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine.
Rumors and official hints have long pointed to a Helix that could play PC games and open the door to rival storefronts such as Steam and the Epic Games Store. That led many observers to expect something closer to a gaming PC, running a custom version of Windows that could also handle console games. Some rumors went further, saying Microsoft might license the hardware to manufacturers like Asus so they could release their own Helix-based boxes.
Ronald described the product the other way around. "We're very clear on the design goal: Helix is designed to be a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC," he said. "It is not a PC that can also play console games. The goal is making it easy, intuitive, and instant to access my games. But if you're a hardcore gamer or a power user who wants to have that deeper level of customizability across settings and performance options, you can absolutely go do it."
That framing matches reports that the Xbox team favors a customized, console-focused operating system rather than a conventional Windows desktop. Microsoft has confirmed that Helix's OS is being built on Windows, but the experience will be tailored to gaming.
Ronald confirmed that the Helix interface "will be its own." It won't be designed from scratch, though. He said the interface will draw on what Microsoft learned from the ROG Xbox Ally handheld and Xbox mode for Windows, both of which bring game libraries from different sources into one front end. Helix appears set to take the same approach and present games from several libraries in one place, so players don't have to jump between separate launchers.
The library itself is a big part of the plan. Ronald called Helix the "ultimate gaming machine," one that "removes all the barriers of play that have historically existed." On the console side, that means access to games spanning four generations: the original Xbox, the Xbox 360, the Xbox One, and the current Xbox Series X|S.
On the PC side, Ronald said the aim is to "remove the arbitrary constraints between console and PC games," a long-standing divide that has kept the two libraries apart even though both run on Microsoft platforms.
His remark about deeper customization points to a hybrid performance model. Consoles usually lock graphics settings in place, and PC players expect a slew of graphics and performance settings they can adjust. Ronald's comments suggest Helix owners could get more control over settings and performance than traditional console users, while the default experience remains simple for everyone else.

articles.title: Shopify, Cohere leaders join call for Jensen Huang to be reinstated as Nvidia CEO | BetaKit
articles.text:
A pair of prominent Canadian technology leaders have joined a broader call demanding that US AI chip giant Nvidia bring co-founder and longtime head Jensen Huang back as CEO.
The news: After 33 years at the helm, Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO last week shortly after public allegations of affairs with two employees and an alleged Chinese spy tied to Singapore’s Megaspeed became public. Shopify co-founder and CEO Tobias Lütke and Cohere co-founder and CEO Aidan Gomez have signed an open letter asking Nvidia’s board of directors to reinstate Huang “pending an independent investigation and clear evidence that his removal serves the company.” That letter has now morphed into an online petition featuring more than 100,000 names. Several Silicon Valley leaders appear on the petition, but it’s not yet clear how many of the signatories are legitimate.
From the source: The letter demands that Nvidia “bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.”
As Lütke wrote on X after Nvidia announced Huang’s departure, “Generational blunder. At least based on the information that’s available.” In a reply, the Shopify CEO added, “Nvidia ends today, and is replaced with a thing cosplaying Nvidia. It will be run by custodians trying and failing to preserve the flame he ignited.”
The context: Nvidia sits at the centre of the ongoing AI boom, providing not only the hardware, models, and software, but serving as a key financier for other companies building in the space. Like many other tech firms, Ottawa-based Shopify is currently leveraging Nvidia’s offerings. Nvidia is also an investor in Gomez’s AI model-making firm, Toronto-based Cohere, as well as local self-driving tech developer Waabi. Canadian pension funds currently hold tens of billions worth of the AI chipmaker’s stock.
Final thought: Huang, who played a pivotal role in Nvidia’s ascent and did not leave a succession plan, has reportedly considered a comeback. While US President Donald Trump has said he is okay with that idea, his treasury secretary, Scott Bessent, has poured water on the notion, and Nvidia has reportedly ruled out the possibility of a return.
Feature image courtesy Wikimedia Commons.

articles.title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
articles.text:
To train an AI model, thousands of GPUs have to work together, requiring a network that’s fast, efficient and resilient.
Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzle with NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics (CPO) switches. The cloud provider is using the switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs, delivering lower power, higher resiliency and longer mean time between interruptions (MTBI) to an AI factory at scale.
“Networking has to keep pace with the demands of increasingly large AI clusters,” said Dave Ward, president of cloud services at Lambda. “Bringing co-packaged optics into a deployment of this scale is an important step toward building the infrastructure needed to support the next generation of AI.”
In the company’s tests using the switches, network latency — the time needed for moving data — dropped by about 4% at rack scale and by up to about 10% at pod scale. Across rack, scalable unit and pod configurations, the network maintains the same throughput as conventional pluggable optics.
Delivering Power Efficiency and Resiliency at Scale
Improving power efficiency and resiliency matters because the network sits at the center of AI factory productivity.
In a large training job, one interrupted link can stall thousands of GPUs. With agentic inference, one network disruption can introduce cascading latency effects on many agents. Every interruption costs time, and every watt spent on networking is a watt not available for compute.
NVIDIA Photonics addresses both power efficiency and resiliency. By replacing pluggable transceivers with co-packaged optical engines on the switch package, it delivers up to 5x better power efficiency and up to 15x higher reliability than conventional pluggable optics. It also uses 4x fewer lasers, which means fewer components that can fail.
Cooler Optics, Replaceable Light Sources Increase Resiliency
Lambda’s deployment uses NVIDIA Photonics switches, each with 144 ports running at 800Gb/s. Liquid cooling carries heat away from the switch chip and optical engines.
The company reports a median optics temperature of 36°C, compared with 51°C for conventional pluggable optics, and its tests find more stable signal integrity.
NVIDIA Photonics also brings the electrical-to-optical conversion closer to the switch chip. Each switch has 18 removable external light sources, which supply light to the optical engines. Optical engines sit alongside the chip on the same package and convert electrical signals into light that carries data over fiber between parts of the cluster.
Technicians can replace the light-source modules in the field, unlike traditional pluggable optics, which require replacing the entire module if a laser fails.
Co-packaging shortens the electrical path from inches to millimeters, which reduces signal loss. It also removes the need for retimer chips, cutting both power draw and the number of parts in the signal path.
Explore NVIDIA Photonics and read Lambda’s deployment announcement.

articles.title: Galaxy S25 Ultra (512 GB) surge com preço imbatível na Black do Magalu • Tecnoblog

Galaxy S25 Ultra (512 GB) surge com preço imbatível na Black do Magalu
Galaxy S25 Ultra (512 GB) com câmera de 200 MP e chip Snapdragon de ponta alcança o menor preço que já vimos, com desconto de 56% no Pix no mês da Black Friday 2026
O Galaxy S25 Ultra de 512 GB está saindo por apenas R$ 5.300 no Pix no Magazine Luiza. O celular premium da Samsung, com chip Snapdragon 8 Elite e câmera wide de 200 MP, recebe desconto de 56% sobre o preço original de R$ 11.999.
Este é o menor preço já publicado pelo Achados, e se aproxima do atual de R$ 5.200 pedido pelo modelo de 256 GB, fazendo desta uma excelente oferta da Black November 2026.
O S25 Ultra se destaca por seu kit principal de câmeras, que filma em 8K. Ele inclui wide de 200 MP com OIS e ultrawide de 50 MP, que captam belas cenas ao ar livre, telefoto de 10 MP com zoom óptico de 3x e periscópica de 50 MP e 5x para aproximações. A frontal de 12 MP tira ótimas selfies e filma em 4K a 60 fps.
Seu chip Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite e os 12 GB de RAM dão conta de apps pesados em multitarefa, games e soluções do Galaxy AI localmente. Os 512 GB de espaço interno dão e sobram para guardar vídeos e fotos.
A tela AMOLED Dinâmico 2X de 6,9″, com taxa de 120 Hz e brilho de até 2.600 nits, reproduz imagens com cores vibrantes, alta fluidez e visibilidade garantida.
O corpo de titânio do S25 Ultra é revestido de ambos os lados pelo vidro Gorilla Armor 2, resistente contra riscos e arranhões. A certificação IP68 confere proteção em cenários como poeira intensa e mergulhos acidentais.
Sua bateria de 5.000 mAh resiste a até 31 horas de reprodução de vídeo, segundo a Samsung. O suporte ao carregamento rápido de 45 W via USB-C e de 15 W sem fio permite o uso prolongado por um dia inteiro.
O Galaxy S25 Ultra de 512 GB (apenas R$ 5.300 no Pix) será atualizado até o Android 22 e possui conectividade 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4 e NFC.
Esse é o nome da campanha 2026 da Black November do Magalu, que oferece cupons de ofertas em gadgets com descontos e condições especiais durante o mês da Black Friday, que ocorre em 27 de novembro.

articles.title: Recent UnrealIRCd Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
articles.text:
Threat actors started exploiting a high-severity vulnerability in the open source Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server UnrealIRCd one day after public disclosure.
Tracked as CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS score: 8.6), the flaw is described as an improper neutralization of delimiters and allows attackers to execute commands with server/IRCOp privileges.
The issue exists because the labeled-response module “does not escape the IRCv3 ‘label’ message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority,” according to a NIST advisory.
Patches for CVE-2026-114713 and eight other bugs were released on November 7 in UnrealIRCd version 6.2.7.1. A hot patch was also rolled out.
According to UnrealIRCd project leader, developer, and maintainer Bram Matthys, this is the most severe security defect discovered in UnrealIRCd.
“Any ordinary user can KILL, GLINE, and do many more bad things. This is the most critical issue found in UnrealIRCd in the past 15 years,” Matthys said.
Matthys has provided instructions on how to update to UnrealIRCd 6.2.7.1 or apply the hot patch and warned that UnrealIRCd 5 and previous releases have reached End of Life (EoL) and won’t receive a fix.
“It is likely that several bugs that are fixed in 6.2.7.1 go all the way back to 3.2.x,” Matthys said.
On November 8, he warned that hackers had already started probing vulnerable UnrealIRCd instances, urging immediate patching.
“We are seeing bad guys exploiting this issue on the internet right now. Hopefully everyone has hot-patched or updated their server, or at the very least has the spamfilter workaround deployed. If not, do so ASAP,” Matthys said.
On November 13, the US cybersecurity agency CISA added CVE-2026-114713 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) list, giving federal agencies only three days to address it, in line with BOD 26-04 requirements.
CISA also added CVE-2026-123039 to KEV. A high-severity flaw affecting multiple Check Point products, it has been exploited in destructive attacks against Israeli organizations, Check Point warned last week.

articles.title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM | TechCrunch
articles.text:
OpenAI today announced new tools to combat child sexual abuse material (CSAM) amid growing safety concerns around the use of AI tools. These features include a new image classifier to detect CSAM, warnings and temporary blocks to prevent users from creating or accessing content that sexualizes children, a new guideline for developers, and a set of tools for law enforcement.
The company unveiled a new image classifier that can detect CSAM images, including the ones generated by AI. OpenAI is giving select companies access to its classifier through its API at no cost. The tool looks for visual signs of abuse in images not seen before and assigns a score that can give an indicative direction to reviewers about dealing with CSAM.
OpenAI said that it developed this classifier with the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC), and it is working with Tech Coalition and ROOST to share access to the tool. In its early testing with partners, the AI company found that the classifier flags 48% fewer images while finding the same number of abusive images, reducing the work of reviewers. Plus, images flagged by the classifier are twice as likely to be abusive images.
What’s more, the company is adding new warning screens in ChatGPT to prevent users from accessing material that sexualizes children. ChatGPT will show an alert to users attempting such prompts, direct users toward specialized support to stop harmful behavior, and also suspend the account for 24 hours as a warning. The app already blocks CSAM content and requests related to it. It said that repeated offences could lead to the account being removed permanently.
OpenAI noted that it formed the message and guidelines around this behavior with organizations and researchers, including Protect Children, the Lucy Faithfull Foundation, and Joel Scanlan at the University of Tasmania, who independently evaluated a trial of deterrent messages.
The company is also publishing guidelines for developers using OpenAI tools to prevent, detect, and help users report CSAM content. It said that in early testing, the guidelines have helped a number of developers adopt child safety tooling and register to report CSAM to NCMEC. OpenAI is also equipping law enforcement dealing with child safety with AI-powered features like dedicated plug-ins, investigative tools, and complex data analysis, with access managed by program administrators. It is also providing training to investigators along with a field guide on how to use AI.
OpenAI has had several lawsuits against the company blaming its technology for harming users, especially children. Safety-focused nonprofit Common Sense Media labeled OpenAI’s tech as “unacceptable risk” for teens. Other AI chatbots — specifically Grok — have been used to create nonconsensual sexualized imagery, including of children.
The AI startup had made changes in the last 12 months to its technology, including releasing a safety blueprint, updating content guidelines to bar inappropriate content, retuning its model to prevent them from generating harmful content, and releasing a special version of ChatGPT for teens.

articles.title: GTA VI terá mapa gigante, clima extremo e novidade surpreendente
articles.text:
O mundo de GTA VI promete ser mais complexo do que simplesmente um cenário aberto para os jogadores provocarem o caos. A Rockstar Games revelou novos detalhes sobre o comportamento dos personagens e o sistema climático do título, enquanto imagens vazadas de um pôster da edição de colecionador mostram mais localidades do mapa.
As novidades indicam que a desenvolvedora está trabalhando em diferentes aspectos da experiência: das consequências das escolhas dos jogadores às mudanças no ambiente durante a exploração de Leonida, estado fictício inspirado na Flórida, nos Estados Unidos.
GTA VI deve incentivar empatia e comportamento mais cuidadoso
- Pela primeira vez na franquia, a Rockstar pretende oferecer mecanismos para incentivar os jogadores a agir de maneira mais cuidadosa. A informação foi compartilhada por Rob Nelson, chefe de desenvolvimento da Rockstar North, e Jennifer Kolbe, chefe de licenciamento da empresa, em entrevista ao jornal The Guardian;
- Segundo Nelson, a ideia está relacionada à história de Jason e Lucia, protagonistas do jogo. O executivo descreveu os dois como um casal jovem que enfrenta dificuldades e explicou que não faria sentido eles simplesmente saírem provocando destruição por onde passam;
- A proposta, porém, não significa que a Rockstar pretende retirar a liberdade característica da série. O crime continuará sendo parte fundamental de GTA, mas as ações dos jogadores poderão influenciar o desenvolvimento da história;
- Questionado sobre a possibilidade de o jogo incentivar empatia, Nelson respondeu que sim. Ele explicou que a empresa está tentando oferecer, pela primeira vez em um título da franquia, mecanismos que estimulem esse comportamento para quem tiver interesse;
- A experiência de Red Dead Redemption 2, lançado em 2018, pode ter influenciado essa abordagem. No faroeste da Rockstar, as decisões de Arthur Morgan afetam a maneira como o mundo reage ao protagonista. O sistema de honra permite, inclusive, moldar a personalidade do personagem ao longo da aventura;
- A empresa, no entanto, não confirmou se GTA VI terá um sistema de honra semelhante.
Tempestades tropicais e clima que muda conforme a região
Outro aspecto que promete chamar a atenção é o sistema meteorológico. A Rockstar revelou ao The Weather Channel que GTA 6 terá chuvas intensas, tempestades tropicais, neblina e ventos fortes, com condições que poderão variar de acordo com a região do mapa.
O objetivo é reproduzir características climáticas da Flórida, que serviu de inspiração para Leonida. Para isso, a desenvolvedora precisou reformular completamente o sistema de clima do jogo.
Owen Shepherd, vice-presidente de arte responsável por iluminação e renderização, explicou que as condições meteorológicas foram projetadas para ser mais localizadas, persistentes e dinâmicas.
Na prática, o clima poderá afetar a exploração de diferentes maneiras. Em Leonida Keys, região formada por ilhas, chuvas intensas podem prejudicar a visibilidade dos motoristas. Algumas rodovias contam com refletores para ajudar na condução durante o mau tempo.
Nas áreas costeiras, tempestades tropicais poderão deixar o mar agitado, com ventos fortes e ondas elevadas que dificultam a navegação. Já a neblina poderá encobrir praias, hotéis e paisagens, enquanto a umidade elevada deve provocar camadas de névoa sobre regiões de baía.
Os pântanos também terão mudanças visuais. Depois de uma tempestade, por exemplo, as águas poderão ficar ainda mais turvas, dificultando a identificação de animais escondidos.
Apesar das demonstrações, a Rockstar não detalhou se as tempestades poderão interferir diretamente nas missões ou provocar acidentes. A empresa confirmou o desenvolvimento de um sistema climático mais dinâmico, mas não explicou todas as consequências para a jogabilidade.
Leia mais:
- GTA 6 terá festival em Miami com Cardi B e Travis Scott; saiba como participar
- GTA 6 pode criar novas oportunidades de trabalho para streamers e editores de vídeos
- GTA 6 terá 30 FPS em todos os consoles, diz Rockstar; PS5 Pro terá vantagens gráficas
Mapa vazado revela novas regiões de Leonida
Enquanto a Rockstar apresenta detalhes do funcionamento do jogo, imagens de um pôster da edição de colecionador revelaram novas informações sobre o território de GTA VI.
As fotografias começaram a circular na internet em 12 de novembro, depois que o material apareceu em uma vitrine da loja Selfridges, em Manchester (Inglaterra). O pôster faz parte da Collector’s Box, coleção anunciada oficialmente pela Rockstar em setembro.
A empresa confirmou que a caixa inclui pôster dupla-face com a paisagem de Leonida, mas não se manifestou sobre o vazamento das imagens.
O material não mostra uma tela técnica do mapa dentro do jogo, mas uma ilustração turística do estado fictício. Uma das artes apresenta rodovias, ilhas, cidades e vias navegáveis. A outra destaca diferentes localidades, com a frase “The Goodtime State” — algo como “O Estado dos Bons Tempos” — em referência ao apelido da Flórida, conhecida como “The Sunshine State”.
Além de Vice City, cidade inspirada em Miami, a Rockstar já havia apresentado cinco grandes regiões de Leonida: Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia e Mount Kalaga National Park. O material promocional também revelou localidades menores, como Little Cuba, nos arredores de Vice City.
As imagens vazadas acrescentaram outros nomes à lista, incluindo Lummox County, Moreau, Manzana, Goose Key, Southwind, Pelican Valley e Key Lento. Também é possível identificar rodovias, pedágios e diferentes áreas costeiras.
Um detalhe curioso é a ilustração de um OVNI sobrevoando uma das regiões. A presença do objeto levantou especulações sobre a possibilidade de o jogo trazer novamente mistérios e referências a extraterrestres, como aconteceu em GTA V. Até o momento, porém, não há confirmação sobre o significado da imagem.
O pôster também apresenta desenhos de animais espalhados pelo território, incluindo tartarugas, jacarés e aves. Segundo informações divulgadas pela própria Rockstar, GTA VI terá mais de 170 espécies de animais, entre elas iguanas, sapos-cururus e macacos.
O território também promete ser bastante amplo. Segundo comparação atribuída a Aaron Garbut, chefe de desenvolvimento e um dos responsáveis pela Rockstar North, o mapa de GTA VI é quase tão grande quanto a soma das áreas jogáveis de GTA IV, GTA V e Red Dead Redemption II.
GTA VI será lançado em 19 de novembro para PlayStation 5 e Xbox Series X|S. A história acompanha Jason e Lucia, dois criminosos que acabam envolvidos em uma conspiração em Leonida. O pré-carregamento do game já está disponível para usuários dos consoles.
Hacker responsável pelo grande vazamento de GTA 6 em 2022 se declara culpado
Arion Kurtaj, integrante do grupo de cibercriminosos Lapsus$, declarou-se culpado em 16 de novembro de 2026 por ataques que incluíram a invasão à Rockstar Games e o vazamento de 90 vídeos de GTA VI, anos antes do lançamento do jogo.
Na época, as imagens revelaram trechos de desenvolvimento do título e detalhes de sua jogabilidade. Kurtaj também foi responsável por ataques contra outras grandes empresas, como Uber e Revolut.
O hacker, atualmente com 21 anos, havia sido condenado em dezembro de 2023 a permanecer em hospital de segurança máxima, em razão de seu autismo. Em janeiro de 2026, porém, foi considerado apto a enfrentar um julgamento e transferido para a prisão.
A sentença relacionada à declaração de culpa está prevista para 23 de novembro de 2026, poucos dias depois do lançamento de GTA VI.
Rodrigo Mozelli é jornalista formado pela Universidade Metodista de São Paulo (UMESP) e, atualmente, é redator do Olhar Digital.
